Hold briefly at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Breathe in and bring down under control the handles back to the start, fully extending your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever calf press
instructions: Adjust the seat so that your legs are only slightly bent in the start position. The balls of your feet should be firmly on the platform.
Select an appropriate weight, and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.

Straighten the legs by extending the knees, just barely lifting the weight from the stack. Your ankle should be fully flexed, toes pointing up. Execute the movement by pressing downward through the balls of your feet as far as possible.
After a brief pause, reverse the motion and repeat.

name: lever chest press
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the bottom or middle of the pectorals at the beginning of the motion.
Your chest and head should be up and your shoulder blades retracted. This will be your starting position.
Press the handles forward by extending through the elbow.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.

name: lever chest press
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the bottom or middle of the pectorals at the beginning of the motion.
Your chest and head should be up and your shoulder blades retracted. This will be your starting position.
Press the handles forward by extending through the elbow.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.

name: lever deadlift
instructions: Load the pins to an appropriate weight. Position yourself directly between the handles. Grasp the bottom handles with a comfortable grip, and then lower your hips as you take a breath. Look forward with your head and keep your chest up. This will be your starting position.
Return the weight to the starting position.

name: lever decline chest press
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the bottom of the pectorals at the beginning of the motion. Your chest and head should be up and your shoulder blades retracted. This will be your starting position.
Press the handles forward by extending through the elbow.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.

name: lever donkey calf raise
instructions: Adjust the leverage machine to the appropriate height for your body.
Stance yourself facing the machine, with your toes on the foot platform and your heels hanging off the edge.
Place your hands on the handles or the support bars for stability.
Activate your calves and lift your heels as high as possible, using the balls of your feet.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your heels back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever front pulldown
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet planted on the floor.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Sit upright with your chest lifted and your shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your bring down back.
Activate your lats and pull the handles down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the bottom of the movement, then in a controlled manner release the handles back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever gripless shrug
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the leverage machine.
Grip the handles with your palms facing inwards and your arms fully extended.
While keeping your back straight, breathe out and elevate your shoulders as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a brief moment, then breathe in and bring down under control your shoulders back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever gripless shrug v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles or bars with an overhand grip, while keeping your arms straight.
While keeping your back straight, lift your shoulders up towards your ears as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then bring down under control your shoulders back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever gripper hands
instructions: Adjust the seat height and grip the handles of the leverage machine.
Keep your back straight and your feet planted on the floor.
Breathe out and squeeze the handles, contracting your forearms.
Hold the contraction for a second, then in a controlled manner release and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever hammer grip preacher curl
instructions: To perform this movement you will need a preacher bench and an E-Z bar. Grab the E-Z curl bar at the close inner handle (either have someone hand you the bar which is preferable or grab the bar from the front bar rest provided by most preacher benches). The palm of your hands should be facing forward and they should be slightly tilted inwards due to the shape of the bar.
With the upper arms positioned against the preacher bench pad and the chest against it, hold the E-Z Curl Bar at shoulder length. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the bar until your upper arm is extended and the biceps is fully stretched.
As you exhale, use the biceps to curl the weight up until your biceps is fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder height. Squeeze the biceps hard and hold this position for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: lever high row
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat height so that you can just reach the handles above you. Adjust the knee pad to help keep you down. Grasp the handles with a pronated grip. This will be your starting position.
Pull the handles towards your torso, retracting your shoulder blades as you flex the elbow.
Pause at the bottom of the motion, and then slowly return the handles to the starting position.
For multiple repetitions, avoid completely returning the weight to the stops to keep tension on the muscles being worked.

name: lever hip extension v. 2
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your feet on the footrests and grip the handles for stability.
Activate your glutes and hamstrings, then push against the footrests to straighten your hips and lift your legs backward.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your legs back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever horizontal one leg press
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock your knees. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be your starting position.
As you inhale, slowly lower the platform until your upper and lower legs make a 90-degree angle.
Pushing mainly with the heels of your feet and using the quadriceps go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and ensure to lock the safety pins properly once you are done. You do not want that platform falling on you fully loaded.

name: lever incline chest press
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the top of the pectorals at the beginning of the motion. Your chest and head should be up and your shoulder blades retracted. This will be your starting position.
Press the handles forward by extending through the elbow.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.

name: lever incline chest press v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest angle on the leverage machine to a comfortable stance.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip and stance your hands slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Push the handles forward and away from your body until your arms are fully extended, but without locking your elbows.
Hold briefly at the fully extended stance, then in a controlled manner flex your elbows and bring down the handles back towards your chest.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever kneeling leg curl
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and select the desired weight.
Kneel on the machine facing downwards, with your knees resting on the pad and your feet secured under the footpads.
Grip the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
While keeping your upper body stationary, breathe out and curl your legs up towards your glutes by flexing your knees.
Hold briefly at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Breathe in and bring down under control your legs back to the start, fully extending your knees.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever kneeling twist
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your knees resting on the pads and your upper body facing forward.
Grip the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
While keeping your core engaged, twist your upper body to one side as far as comfortably possible.
Hold briefly, then in a controlled manner come back to where you began.
Do it again the twist to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: lever lateral raise
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms straight.
Breathe out and lift your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.
Hold briefly at the top, then breathe in and bring down under control your arms back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever leg extension
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the machine to fit your body.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footpad.
Grip the handles or sidebars for stability.
Straighten your legs forward by straightening your knees, lifting the weight.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the weight back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever lying leg curl
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and select the desired weight.
Lay face down on the machine with your legs straight and your heels against the padded lever.
Grip the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
While keeping your upper body stationary, breathe out and curl your legs up as far as possible without lifting your hips off the pad.
Hold the contracted stance for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Breathe in and bring down under control the lever back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever lying two-one leg curl
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your legs on the lever pad, just above your ankles.
Grip the handles on the sides of the machine for support.
While keeping your upper body still, breathe out and curl your legs up towards your glutes.
Hold briefly at the top, then breathe in and bring down under control your legs back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever military press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip and stance your hands slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Push the handles upward until your arms are fully extended, but do not lock your elbows.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the handles back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever narrow grip seated row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footrests to ensure proper form.
Sit on the machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grip the handles with a narrow grip, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward.
Pull the handles towards your upper body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the peak of the movement.
In a controlled manner release the handles and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever one arm bent over row
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width, knees slightly bent, and hold a barbell with an overhand grip.
Flex forward at the hips, while keeping your back straight and your head up.
Let the barbell hang in front of you with your arms fully extended.
Pull the barbell up towards your chest, while keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Bring down the barbell back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever one arm lateral high row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself facing the machine.
Grip the handle with one hand and keep your back straight.
Pull the handle towards your body, while keeping your elbow close to your side.
Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the movement.
In a controlled manner release the handle back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever one arm lateral wide pulldown
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handle with an overhand grip and fully straighten your arm, keeping a slight flex in your elbow.
Pull the handle down and across your body towards your opposite hip, squeezing your lat muscle at the bottom of the movement.
In a controlled manner go back the handle to the start stance, fully extending your arm.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch sides.

name: lever one arm shoulder press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the lever handle with one hand and stance your elbow at a 90-degree angle.
Press the lever upward until your arm is fully extended overhead.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the lever back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch to the other arm.

name: lever overhand triceps dip
instructions: Adjust the machine to the appropriate height and secure your body in stance.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip and stance your body so that your arms are fully extended.
Bring down your body by bending your elbows, while keeping your upper arms close to your sides.
Continue lowering until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Hold briefly, then push yourself back up to the start stance by extending your elbows.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever preacher curl
instructions: To perform this movement you will need a preacher bench and an E-Z bar. Grab the E-Z curl bar at the close inner handle (either have someone hand you the bar which is preferable or grab the bar from the front bar rest provided by most preacher benches). The palm of your hands should be facing forward and they should be slightly tilted inwards due to the shape of the bar.
With the upper arms positioned against the preacher bench pad and the chest against it, hold the E-Z Curl Bar at shoulder length. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the bar until your upper arm is extended and the biceps is fully stretched.
As you exhale, use the biceps to curl the weight up until your biceps is fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder height. Squeeze the biceps hard and hold this position for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: lever preacher curl v. 2
instructions: To perform this movement you will need a preacher bench and an E-Z bar. Grab the E-Z curl bar at the close inner handle (either have someone hand you the bar which is preferable or grab the bar from the front bar rest provided by most preacher benches). The palm of your hands should be facing forward and they should be slightly tilted inwards due to the shape of the bar.
With the upper arms positioned against the preacher bench pad and the chest against it, hold the E-Z Curl Bar at shoulder length. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the bar until your upper arm is extended and the biceps is fully stretched.
As you exhale, use the biceps to curl the weight up until your biceps is fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder height. Squeeze the biceps hard and hold this position for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: lever pullover
instructions: Adjust the seat and handles of the leverage machine to a comfortable stance.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grip the handles with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms slightly bent and your core engaged.
In a controlled manner pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your lats.
Hold briefly at the peak contraction, then in a controlled manner come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever reverse grip lateral pulldown
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet planted on the floor.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Sit upright with your chest out and shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your bring down back.
Pull the handles down towards your chest, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the bottom of the movement, then in a controlled manner release the handles back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever reverse grip preacher curl
instructions: To perform this movement you will need a preacher bench and an E-Z bar. Grab the E-Z curl bar at the close inner handle (either have someone hand you the bar which is preferable or grab the bar from the front bar rest provided by most preacher benches). The palm of your hands should be facing forward and they should be slightly tilted inwards due to the shape of the bar.
With the upper arms positioned against the preacher bench pad and the chest against it, hold the E-Z Curl Bar at shoulder length. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the bar until your upper arm is extended and the biceps is fully stretched.
As you exhale, use the biceps to curl the weight up until your biceps is fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder height. Squeeze the biceps hard and hold this position for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: lever reverse grip vertical row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footplate stance to ensure proper alignment.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate.
Grip the handles with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your back straight and activate your core.
Pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the top of the movement, then in a controlled manner release and straighten your arms back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever reverse hyperextension
instructions: Place your feet between the pads after loading an appropriate weight. Lay on the top pad, allowing your hips to hang off the back, while grasping the handles to hold your position.
To begin the movement, flex the hips, pulling the legs forward.
Reverse the motion by extending the hips, kicking the leg back. It is very important not to over-extend the hip on this movement, stopping short of your full range of motion.
Return by again flexing the hip, pulling the carriage forward as far as you can.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: lever reverse t-bar row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footplate stance on the leverage machine.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Keep your back straight and activate your core.
Pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the top of the movement, then in a controlled manner release and straighten your arms back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever rotary calf
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are slightly bent and your feet are flat on the footplate.
Place your toes on the footplate, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grip the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Push through the balls of your feet, raising your heels as high as possible.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your heels back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever seated calf press
instructions: Adjust the seat so that your legs are only slightly bent in the start position. The balls of your feet should be firmly on the platform.
Select an appropriate weight, and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.

Straighten the legs by extending the knees, just barely lifting the weight from the stack. Your ankle should be fully flexed, toes pointing up. Execute the movement by pressing downward through the balls of your feet as far as possible.
After a brief pause, reverse the motion and repeat.

name: lever seated calf raise
instructions: Sit on the machine and place your toes on the lower portion of the platform provided with the heels extending off. Choose the toe positioning of your choice (forward, in, or out) as per the beginning of this chapter.

Place your lower thighs under the lever pad, which will need to be adjusted according to the height of your thighs. Now place your hands on top of the lever pad in order to prevent it from slipping forward.
Lift the lever slightly by pushing your heels up and release the safety bar. This will be your starting position.
Slowly lower your heels by bending at the ankles until the calves are fully stretched. Inhale as you perform this movement.
Raise the heels by extending the ankles as high as possible as you contract the calves and breathe out. Hold the top contraction for a second.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: lever seated crunch
instructions: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles or place your hands on the side pads for support.
Activate your abs and in a controlled manner lean back, allowing the pad to move with you.
Once your upper body is at a 45-degree angle, squeeze your abs and crunch forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Hold briefly at the top, then in a controlled manner release and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever seated crunch (chest pad)
instructions: Adjust the seat height and chest pad stance according to your comfort.
Sit on the machine with your back against the chest pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles or side bars for stability.
Activate your abs and in a controlled manner lean back, allowing the chest pad to move with you.
Hold briefly at the maximum contraction, feeling the tension in your abs.
In a controlled manner come back to where you began by contracting your abs and pulling yourself back up.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever seated crunch v. 2
instructions: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the pad and your feet secured under the footpads.
Place your hands on the handles or the sides of the seat for support.
Activate your abs and in a controlled manner crunch forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Hold briefly at the top of the movement, squeezing your abs.
In a controlled manner come back to where you began, allowing your back to round slightly.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever seated dip
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your feet are flat on the floor and your knees are at a 90-degree angle.
Grip the handles of the leverage machine with your palms facing down and your arms fully extended.
Bring down under control your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Hold briefly, then push yourself back up to the start stance by straightening your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever seated fly
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with a pronated grip and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Breathe out and push the handles forward, bringing them together in front of your chest.
Hold briefly, squeezing your chest muscles.
Breathe in and in a controlled manner come back to where you began, allowing your chest muscles to stretch.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever seated good morning
instructions: Begin with a bar on a rack at shoulder height. Rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your shoulders. Keep your back tight, shoulder blades pinched together, and your knees slightly bent. Step back from the rack.
Begin by bending at the hips, moving them back as you bend over to near parallel. Keep your back arched and your cervical spine in proper alignment.
Reverse the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings. Continue until you have returned to the starting position.

name: lever seated hip abduction
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footrests.
Place your hands on the side handles for stability.
Activate your abductors and in a controlled manner push your legs apart, away from the midline of your body.
Hold briefly at the end of the movement, then in a controlled manner bring your legs back together to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever seated hip adduction
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Place your feet on the footrests and grip the handles for stability.
Activate your adductor muscles and in a controlled manner bring your legs together, squeezing your inner thighs.
Hold briefly at the peak contraction, then in a controlled manner come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever seated leg curl
instructions: Adjust the machine lever to fit your height and sit on the machine with your back against the back support pad.

Place the back of lower leg on top of padded lever (just a few inches under the calves) and secure the lap pad against your thighs, just above the knees. Then grasp the side handles on the machine as you point your toes straight (or you can also use any of the other two stances) and ensure that the legs are fully straight right in front of you. This will be your starting position.
As you exhale, pull the machine lever as far as possible to the back of your thighs by flexing at the knees. Keep your torso stationary at all times. Hold the contracted position for a second.
Slowly return to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: lever seated leg raise crunch
instructions: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footrests.
Grip the handles or sidebars for stability.
Activate your abs and lift steadily your legs up towards your chest, curling your upper body forward at the same time.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your legs and upper body back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever seated reverse fly
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms slightly bent.
Breathe out and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
Hold briefly at the peak contraction, then breathe in and in a controlled manner come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever seated reverse fly (parallel grip)
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles with a parallel grip, palms facing each other, and keep your arms slightly bent.
Breathe out and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
Hold briefly at the peak contraction, then breathe in and in a controlled manner come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever seated row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footrests to a comfortable stance.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet on the footrests.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip, about shoulder width.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the peak of the movement.
In a controlled manner release the handles and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever seated squat calf raise on leg press machine
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock your knees. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be your starting position.
As you inhale, slowly lower the platform until your upper and lower legs make a 90-degree angle.
Pushing mainly with the heels of your feet and using the quadriceps go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and ensure to lock the safety pins properly once you are done. You do not want that platform falling on you fully loaded.

name: lever shoulder press
instructions: Load an appropriate weight onto the pins and adjust the seat for your height. The handles should be near the top of the shoulders at the beginning of the motion. Your chest and head should be up and handles held with a pronated grip. This will be your starting position.
Press the handles upward by extending through the elbow.
After a brief pause at the top, return the weight to just above the start position, keeping tension on the muscles by not returning the weight to the stops until the set is complete.

name: lever shoulder press v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable stance.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles of the machine with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Push the handles upward and forward until your arms are fully extended, but not locked.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the handles back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever shoulder press v. 3
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable stance.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles of the machine with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Push the handles upward and forward until your arms are fully extended, but not locked.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the handles back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever shrug
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the leverage machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms straight.
While keeping your back straight, lift your shoulders up towards your ears as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then bring down under control your shoulders back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever standing calf raise
instructions: Adjust the machine to your height and stand with your feet about shoulder width.
Place your shoulders under the pads and hold onto the handles for stability.
Lift your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your heels back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever standing chest press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your feet planted on the floor.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip and stance your hands at chest level.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, while keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Hold briefly, then in a controlled manner bring the handles back towards your chest, maintaining control through the whole movement.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever t bar row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footplate stance to ensure proper alignment.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Keep your back straight and activate your core.
Pull the handles towards your upper body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the peak contraction, then in a controlled manner release the handles back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever t-bar reverse grip row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Keep your back straight and activate your core.
Pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the top of the movement, then in a controlled manner release and straighten your arms back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever triceps extension
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip and fully straighten your arms in front of you.
While keeping your upper arms stationary, bring down under control the handles towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push the handles back up to the start stance by extending your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lever unilateral row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself facing the machine.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip and keep your back straight.
Pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the peak of the movement, then in a controlled manner release and straighten your arms back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: london bridge
instructions: Attach a climbing rope to a high beam or cross member. Below it, ensure that the smith machine bar is locked in place with the safeties and cannot move. Alternatively, a secure box could also be utilized.
Stand on the bar, using the rope to balance yourself. This will be your starting position.
Keeping your body straight, lean back and lower your body by slowly going hand over hand with the rope. Continue until you are perpendicular to the ground.
Keeping your body straight, reverse the motion, going hand over hand back to the starting position.

name: low glute bridge on floor
instructions: Lay flat on your back with your knees bent and feet planted on the floor.
Place your arms by your sides, palms facing down.
Activate your glutes and core, then lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold briefly at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Bring down under control your hips back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: lower back curl
instructions: Lie on your stomach with your arms out to your sides. This will be your starting position.
Using your lower back muscles, extend your spine lifting your chest off of the ground. Do not use your arms to push yourself up. Keep your head up during the movement. Repeat for 10-20 repetitions.

name: lunge with jump
instructions: Start by standing with your feet about shoulder width.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge stance.
Push off with your right foot and jump into the air, switching the stance of your feet mid-air.
Land softly with your left foot forward and immediately bring down your body into a lunge stance.
Continue alternating between lunges and jumps for your target rep count.

name: lunge with twist
instructions: Start by standing with your feet about shoulder width.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge stance.
As you lunge, twist your upper body to the right, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Hold briefly, then come back to where you began.
Do it again on the other side, stepping forward with your left foot and twisting your upper body to the left.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: lying (side) quads stretch
instructions: Lay on your side with your legs straight.
Flex your top leg and take hold of your ankle or foot with your hand.
Gently pull your ankle or foot towards your glutes until you feel a stretch in your quads.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the stretch and do it again on the other side.

name: lying elbow to knee
instructions: Lie on the floor, crossing your right leg across your bent left knee. Clasp your hands behind your head, beginning with your shoulder blades on the ground. This will be your starting position.
Perform the motion by flexing the spine and rotating your torso to bring the left elbow to the right knee.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.

name: lying leg raise flat bench
instructions: Lie with your back flat on a bench and your legs extended in front of you off the end.
Place your hands either under your glutes with your palms down or by the sides holding on to the bench. This will be your starting position.

As you keep your legs extended, straight as possible with your knees slightly bent but locked raise your legs until they make a 90-degree angle with the floor. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement and hold the contraction at the top for a second.
Now, as you inhale, slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.

name: lying leg-hip raise
instructions: Lay flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Activate your core and lift your legs off the ground, raising them towards the ceiling.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your legs back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: machine inner chest press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your back flat against the pad.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip and stance your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, exhaling during the movement.
Hold briefly at the end of the movement, then in a controlled manner come back to where you began, inhaling as you do so.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: march sit (wall)
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet about hip width.
In a controlled manner slide your back down the wall until your knees are bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lift your right foot off the ground and bring your knee towards your chest.
Bring down your right foot back down and lift your left foot off the ground, bringing your knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating between lifting your right and left foot for your target rep count.

name: medicine ball catch and overhead throw
instructions: Begin standing while facing a wall or a partner.
Using both hands, position the ball behind your head, stretching as much as possible, and forcefully throw the ball forward.

Ensure that you follow your throw through, being prepared to receive your rebound from your throw. If you are throwing against the wall, make sure that you stand close enough to the wall to receive the rebound, and aim a little higher than you would with a partner.

name: medicine ball chest pass
instructions: You will need a partner for this exercise. Lacking one, this movement can be performed against a wall.
Begin facing your partner holding the medicine ball at your torso with both hands.
Pull the ball to your chest, and reverse the motion by extending through the elbows. For sports applications, you can take a step as you throw.
Your partner should catch the ball, and throw it back to you.
Receive the throw with both hands at chest height.

name: medicine ball chest push from 3 point stance
instructions: Begin in a three point stance, squatted down with your back flat and one hand on the ground. Place the medicine ball directly in front of you.
To begin, take your first step as you pull the ball to your chest, positioning both hands to prepare for the throw.
As you execute the second step, explosively release the ball forward as hard as possible.

name: medicine ball chest push multiple response
instructions: Begin in a kneeling position facing a wall or utilize a partner. Hold the ball with both hands tight into the chest.
Execute the pass by exploding forward and outward with the hips while pushing the ball as hard as possible.
Follow through by falling forward, catching yourself with your hands.
Immediately return to an upright position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: medicine ball chest push single response
instructions: Begin in a kneeling position holding the medicine ball with both hands tightly into the chest.
Execute the pass by exploding forward and outward with the hips while pushing the ball as far as possible.
Follow through by falling forward, catching yourself with your hands.

name: medicine ball chest push with run release
instructions: Begin in an athletic stance with the knees bent, hips back, and back flat. Hold the medicine ball near your legs. This will be your starting position.
While taking your first step draw the medicine ball into your chest.
As you take the second step, explosively push the ball forward, immediately sprinting for 10 yards after the release. If you are really fast, you can catch your own pass!

name: medicine ball close grip push up
instructions: Start in a high plank stance with your hands on the medicine ball, about shoulder width.
Bring down your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Push back up to the start stance, fully extending your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: medicine ball overhead slam
instructions: Hold a medine ball with both hands and stand with your feet at shoulder width. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the countermovement by raising the ball above your head and fully extending your body.
Reverse the motion, slamming the ball into the ground directly in front of you as hard as you can.
Receive the ball with both hands on the bounce and repeat the movement.

name: medicine ball supine chest throw
instructions: This drill is great for chest passes when you lack a partner or a wall of sufficient strength. Lay on the ground on your back with your knees bent.
Begin with the ball on your chest, held with both hands on the bottom.
Explode up, extending through the elbow to throw the ball directly above you as high as possible.
Catch the ball with both hands as it comes down.

name: mixed grip chin-up
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing your torso and a grip closer than the shoulder width.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, keep your torso as straight as possible while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position. Tip: Keeping the torso as straight as possible maximizes biceps stimulation while minimizing back involvement.

As you breathe out, pull your torso up until your head is around the level of the pull-up bar. Concentrate on using the biceps muscles in order to perform the movement. Keep the elbows close to your body. Tip: The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.

After a second of squeezing the biceps in the contracted position, slowly lower your torso back to the starting position; when your arms are fully extended. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: modified hindu push-up (male)
instructions: Start in a push-up stance with your hands slightly wider than about shoulder width and your feet about hip width.
Bring down your body towards the ground, bending your elbows and while keeping your core engaged.
As you bring down your body, shift your weight back and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, creating an inverted V shape with your body.
Continue to bring down your body until your chest is just above the ground, then reverse the movement, pushing your hips back down and extending your arms to come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: modified push up to lower arms
instructions: Start in a push-up stance with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Bring down your body down towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Once your elbows are at a 90-degree angle, bring down your forearms to the ground, while keeping your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Hold briefly, then push through your palms to lift your forearms back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: monster walk
instructions: Place a band around both ankles and another around both knees. There should be enough tension that they are tight when your feet are shoulder width apart.
To begin, take short steps forward alternating your left and right foot.
After several steps, do just the opposite and walk backward to where you started.

name: mountain climber
instructions: Begin in a pushup position, with your weight supported by your hands and toes. Flexing the knee and hip, bring one leg until the knee is approximately under the hip. This will be your starting position.

Explosively reverse the positions of your legs, extending the bent leg until the leg is straight and supported by the toe, and bringing the other foot up with the hip and knee flexed. Repeat in an alternating fashion for 20-30 seconds.

name: muscle up
instructions: Grip the rings using a false grip, with the base of your palms on top of the rings. Initiate a pull up by pulling the elbows down to your side, flexing the elbows.

As you reach the top position of the pull-up, pull the rings to your armpits as you roll your shoulders forward, allowing your elbows to move straight back behind you. This puts you into the proper position to continue into the dip portion of the movement.
Maintaining control and stability, extend through the elbow to complete the motion.
Use care when lowering yourself to the ground.

name: muscle-up (on vertical bar)
instructions: Grip the rings using a false grip, with the base of your palms on top of the rings. Initiate a pull up by pulling the elbows down to your side, flexing the elbows.

As you reach the top position of the pull-up, pull the rings to your armpits as you roll your shoulders forward, allowing your elbows to move straight back behind you. This puts you into the proper position to continue into the dip portion of the movement.
Maintaining control and stability, extend through the elbow to complete the motion.
Use care when lowering yourself to the ground.

name: narrow push-up on exercise ball
instructions: Place the stability ball on the floor and stance yourself in a push-up stance with your hands on the ball, slightly narrower than about shoulder width.
Activate your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Bring down your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the start stance by straightening your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: neck side stretch
instructions: Start with your shoulders relaxed, gently tilt your head towards your shoulder.
Assist stretch with a gentle pull on the side of the head.

name: negative crunch
instructions: Lay flat on your back with your knees bent and feet planted on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
By activating your abs, lift steadily your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your upper body is at a 45-degree angle.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your upper body back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: oblique crunch v. 2
instructions: Lay on your back with your knees bent and feet planted on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Activate your abs and lift your shoulder blades off the ground, rotating your upper body to one side.
Hold briefly, then bring down your shoulder blades back down to the start stance.
Do it again on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: oblique crunches floor
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground, or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle. If you are resting your feet on a bench, place them three to four inches apart and point your toes inward so they touch.
Now place your hands lightly on either side of your head keeping your elbows in. Tip: Don't lock your fingers behind your head.
While pushing the small of your back down in the floor to better isolate your abdominal muscles, begin to roll your shoulders off the floor.

Continue to push down as hard as you can with your lower back as you contract your abdominals and exhale. Your shoulders should come up off the floor only about four inches, and your lower back should remain on the floor. At the top of the movement, contract your abdominals hard and keep the contraction for a second. Tip: Focus on slow, controlled movement - don't cheat yourself by using momentum.
After the one second contraction, begin to come down slowly again to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: olympic barbell hammer curl
instructions: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder width and hold an Olympic barbell with an overhand grip.
Let the barbell hang at arm's length in front of your thighs, with your palms facing your body.
While keeping your upper arms stationary, breathe out and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to lift the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the barbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted stance for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Breathe in and in a controlled manner begin to bring down the barbell back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: olympic barbell triceps extension
instructions: Start by standing with your feet about shoulder width and holding the barbell with an overhand grip.
Lift the barbell above your head, fully extending your arms.
While keeping your upper arms close to your head, bring down under control the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Hold briefly, then straighten your arms back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: one arm against wall
instructions: From a standing position, place a bent arm against a wall or doorway.
Slowly lean toward your arm until you feel a stretch in your lats.

name: one arm chin-up
instructions: For this exercise, start out by placing a towel around a chin up bar.
Grab the chin-up bar with your palm facing you. One hand will be grabbing the chin-up bar and the other will be grabbing the towel.
Bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.v

Pull your torso up until the bar touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.
After a second on the contracted position, start to inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
Switch arms and repeat the movement.

name: one arm dip
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench or chair, with your feet about shoulder width.
Place one hand on the bench or chair behind you, fingers pointing towards your body.
Straighten your legs out in front of you, while keeping your heels on the floor.
Flex your elbows and bring down your body towards the ground, while keeping your back close to the bench or chair.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push through your palms to straighten your arms and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch sides and do it again with the other arm.

name: one arm slam (with medicine ball)
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width, holding the medicine ball with one hand in front of your waist.
Flex your knees slightly and activate your core.
Lift the medicine ball above your head, fully extending your arm.
Forcefully slam the medicine ball down to the ground, using your core and shoulders to generate power.
Catch the medicine ball on the bounce and continue for your target number of reps.

name: one arm towel row
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width, knees slightly bent, and hold a towel with one hand.
Flex forward at the waist, while keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Straighten your arm fully, allowing the towel to hang in front of you.
Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the towel back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch arms.

name: one leg donkey calf raise
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width, toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on a stable surface for support, such as a wall or a bar.
Lift one leg off the ground, while keeping your knee slightly bent.
Lift your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your heel back down.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch legs.

name: one leg floor calf raise
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip width and place your hands on a wall or sturdy object for balance.
Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Lift steadily your heel off the ground, lifting your body up onto the ball of your foot.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your heel back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch legs and do it again.

name: one leg squat
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width.
Straighten one leg forward, keeping it off the ground.
Flex your standing leg and bring down your body down as if sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Push through your heel to come back to where you began.
Do it again with the other leg.

name: otis up
instructions: Secure your feet and lay back on the floor. Your knees should be bent. Hold a weight with both hands to your chest. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by flexing the hips and spine to raise your torso up from the ground.
As you move up, press the weight up so that it is above your head at the top of the movement.
Return the weight to your chest as you reverse the sit-up motion, ensuring not to go all the way down to the floor.

name: outside leg kick push-up
instructions: Start in a push-up stance with your hands slightly wider than about shoulder width and your feet together.
Bring down your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, while keeping your back straight and core engaged.
As you push back up, kick one leg out to the side, extending it fully and by activating your glutes.
Go back your leg to the start stance and do it again the push-up, alternating legs with each rep.
Continue alternating leg kicks and push-ups for your target rep count.

name: overhead triceps stretch
instructions: Sit upright on the floor with your partner behind you. Raise one arm straight up, and flex the elbow, attempting to touch your hand to your back. Your parner should hold your elbow and wrist. This will be your starting position.
Attempt to extend the arm straight into the air as your partner prevents you from doing actually doing so.
After 10-20 seconds, relax the arm and allow your partner to further stretch the tricep by applying gentle pressure to the wrist. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then switch sides.

name: pelvic tilt
instructions: Lie down with your feet on the floor, heels directly under your knees.
Lift only your tailbone to the ceiling to stretch your lower back. (Don't lift the entire spine yet.) Pull in your stomach.
To go into a bridge, lift the entire spine except the neck.

name: pelvic tilt into bridge
instructions: Lie down with your feet on the floor, heels directly under your knees.
Lift only your tailbone to the ceiling to stretch your lower back. (Don't lift the entire spine yet.) Pull in your stomach.
To go into a bridge, lift the entire spine except the neck.

name: peroneals stretch
instructions: In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. This will be your starting position.

With the leg extended and the heel off of the ground, pull on the belt so that the foot is inverted, with the inside of the foot being pulled towards you. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then switch sides.

name: pike-to-cobra push-up
instructions: Start in a push-up stance with your hands slightly wider than about shoulder width and your feet together.
Activate your core and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, forming an inverted V shape with your body.
Bring down your upper body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
As you bring down down, shift your weight forward and transition into a cobra pose by straightening your arms and lifting your chest up.
Reverse the movement by bending your elbows and lowering your chest back down towards the ground.
Push through your hands to go back to the inverted V stance.
Continue the movement by lowering your hips back down towards the ground, returning to the starting push-up stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: plyo push up
instructions: Move into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your hands and toes.
Your arms should be fully extended with the hands around shoulder width. Keep your body straight throughout the movement. This will be your starting position.
Descend by flexing at the elbow, lowering your chest towards the ground.
At the bottom, reverse the motion by pushing yourself up through elbow extension as quickly as possible. Attempt to push your upper body up until your hands leave the ground.
Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
For added difficulty, add claps into the movement while you are air borne.

name: posterior step to overhead reach
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip width and your arms by your sides.
Take a step back with your right foot, landing on the ball of your foot.
Flex your left knee and bring down your body into a lunge stance.
As you bring down into the lunge, simultaneously reach your arms overhead.
Hold briefly at the bottom of the lunge, then come back to where you began by pushing through your left heel and bringing your right foot forward.
Do it again the movement on the other side, stepping back with your left foot and bending your right knee.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: posterior tibialis stretch
instructions: In a seated position, loop a belt, rope, or band around one foot. This will be your starting position.

With the leg extended and the heel off of the ground, pull on the belt so that the foot is everted, with the outside of the foot being pulled towards you. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then switch sides.

name: potty squat
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width, toes pointing slightly outward.
Bring down your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if you were sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight through the whole movement.
Bring down yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can comfortably go.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push through your heels to come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: potty squat with support
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width, toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold onto a stable support, such as a chair or wall, for balance.
Bring down your body down into a squat stance by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest up and your back straight through the whole movement.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push through your heels to come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: power clean
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart and toes pointing out slightly.
Squat down and grasp bar with a closed, pronated grip. Your hands should be slightly wider than shoulder width apart outside knees with elbows fully extended.
Place the bar about 1 inch in front of your shins and over the balls of your feet.
Your back should be flat or slightly arched, your chest held up and out and your shoulder blades should be retracted.
Keep your head in a neutral position (in line with vertebral column and not tilted or rotated) with your eyes focused straight ahead. Inhale during this phase.

Lift the bar from the floor by forcefully extending the hips and the knees as you exhale. Tip: The upper torso should maintain the same angle. Do not bend at the waist yet and do not let the hips rise before the shoulders (this would have the effect of pushing the glutes in the air and stretching the hamstrings.
Keep elbows fully extended with the head in a neutral position and the shoulders over the bar.
As the bar raises keep it as close to the shins as possible.
As the bar passes the knees, thrust your hips forward and slightly bend the knees to avoid locking them. Tip: At this point your thighs should be against the bar.
Keep the back flat or slightly arched, elbows fully extended and your head neutral. Tip: You will hold your breath until the next phase.
Inhale and then forcefully and quickly extend your hips and knees and stand on your toes.

Keep the bar as close to your body as possible. Tip: Your back should be flat with the elbows pointed out to the sides and your head in a neutral position. Also, keep your shoulders over the bar and arms straight as long as possible.
When your lower body joints are fully extended, shrug the shoulders upward rapidly without letting the elbows flex yet. Exhale during this portion of the movement.
As the shoulders reach their highest elevation flex your elbows to begin pulling your body under the bar.

Continue to pull the arms as high and as long as possible. Tip: Due to the explosive nature of this phase, your torso will be erect or with an arched back, your head will be tilted back slightly and your feet may lose contact with the floor.
After the lower body has fully extended and the bar reaches near maximal height, pull your body under the bar and rotate the arms around and under the bar.
Simultaneously, flex the hips and knees into a quarter squat position.
Once the arms are under the bar, inhale and then lift your elbows to position the upper arms parallel to the floor. Rack the bar across the front of your collar bones and front shoulder muscles.
Catch the bar with an erect and tight torso, a neutral head position and flat feet. Exhale during this movement.
Stand up by extending the hips and knees to a fully erect position.
Lower the bar by gradually reducing the muscular tension of the arms to allow a controlled descent of the bar to the thighs. Inhale during this movement.
Simultaneously flex the hips and knees to cushion the impact of the bar on the thighs.
Squat down with the elbows fully extended until the bar touches the floor.
Start over at Phase 1 and repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: power point plank
instructions: Get into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your toes and your forearms. Your arms are bent and directly below the shoulder.
Keep your body straight at all times, and hold this position as long as possible. To increase difficulty, an arm or leg can be raised.

name: prisoner half sit-up (male)
instructions: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Place your hands behind your head and lock them together by clasping your fingers. This is the starting position.
Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Breathe out when performing this part of the exercise.
Once you feel the contraction for a second, lower your upper body back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: prone twist on stability ball
instructions: Start by lying face down on a stability ball with your feet about shoulder width and your toes touching the ground.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Activate your core muscles and lift steadily your upper body off the ball, while keeping your back straight.
Rotate your upper body to one side, bringing your shoulder towards your hip. Keep your hips and legs stable through the whole movement.
Hold briefly, then come back to where you began.
Do it again the rotation to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: pull up (neutral grip)
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and your arms fully extended.
Activate your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbows and driving your elbows down towards your hips.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your body back down to the start stance with control.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: pull-in (on stability ball)
instructions: Start by sitting on the stability ball with your feet planted on the floor and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands on the sides of the stability ball for support.
Activate your abs and in a controlled manner roll your hips forward, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Hold briefly at the top of the movement, then in a controlled manner straighten your legs back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: pull-up
instructions: Choke the band around the center of the pullup bar. You can use different bands to provide varying levels of assistance.
Pull the end of the band down, and place one bent knee into the loop, ensuring it won't slip out. Take a medium to wide grip on the bar. This will be your starting position.

Pull yourself upward by contracting the lats as you flex the elbow. The elbow should be driven to your side. Pull to the front, attempting to get your chin over the bar. Avoid swinging or jerking movements.
After a brief pause, return to the starting position.

name: push and pull bodyweight
instructions: Start in a push-up stance with your hands slightly wider than about shoulder width and your body in a straight line.
Bring down your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, while keeping your body straight.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and come back to where you began.
From the push-up stance, pull your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, while keeping your body straight.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: push to run
instructions: Start in a push-up stance with your hands about shoulder width and your body in a straight line.
Bring down your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, while keeping your body straight.
Push through your hands to straighten your arms and come back to where you began.
Quickly bring one knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring the other knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating knees as fast as you can while maintaining good form.
Continue for the desired duration or number of reps.

name: push up on bosu ball
instructions: Place the bosu ball on the floor with the flat side facing up.
Stance yourself in a push-up stance with your hands on the outer edges of the bosu ball.
Activate your core and bring down your body down towards the bosu ball by bending your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the start stance by extending your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: push-up
instructions: Move into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your hands and toes.
Your arms should be fully extended with the hands around shoulder width. Keep your body straight throughout the movement. This will be your starting position.
Descend by flexing at the elbow, lowering your chest toward the ground.
At the bottom, reverse the motion by pushing yourself up through elbow extension as quickly as possible until you are air borne. Aim to "jump" 12-18 inches to one side.
As you accelerate up, move your outside foot away from your direction of travel. Leaving the ground, shift your body about 30 degrees for the next repetition.
Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise, working all the way around until you are back where you started.

name: push-up (bosu ball)
instructions: Place the bosu ball on the floor with the flat side facing up.
Stance yourself in a push-up stance with your hands on the outer edges of the bosu ball.
Activate your core and bring down your body down towards the bosu ball by bending your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the start stance by extending your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: push-up (on stability ball)
instructions: Place the stability ball on the floor and stance yourself facing down with your hands on the ball, about shoulder width.
Straighten your legs straight out behind you, balancing on your toes.
Activate your core and bring down your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, while keeping your body in a straight line.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the start stance by straightening your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: push-up (on stability ball)
instructions: Place the stability ball on the floor and stance yourself facing down with your hands on the ball, about shoulder width.
Straighten your legs straight out behind you, balancing on your toes.
Activate your core and bring down your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, while keeping your body in a straight line.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the start stance by straightening your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: push-up (wall)
instructions: Stand facing a wall, about arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Step back a few feet, while keeping your body straight and your feet about hip width.
Flex your elbows and bring down your chest towards the wall, while keeping your body in a straight line.
Push back up to the start stance, straightening your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: push-up (wall) v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a wall, about arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Step back with your feet, keeping them about hip width.
Activate your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Flex your elbows and bring down your chest towards the wall, while keeping your body straight.
Hold briefly, then push yourself back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: push-up close-grip off dumbbell
instructions: Start in a push-up stance with your hands placed close together, directly under your shoulders.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, resting them on the floor.
Bring down your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: push-up inside leg kick
instructions: Start in a push-up stance with your hands slightly wider than about shoulder width and your feet together.
Bring down your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, while keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
As you push back up, lift one leg off the ground and kick it out to the side, keeping it straight.
Bring down your leg back down and do it again the push-up, then switch to the other leg.
Continue alternating leg kicks with each push-up rep.

name: push-up medicine ball
instructions: Start in a high plank stance with your hands on the medicine ball, about shoulder width.
Activate your core and bring down your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, while keeping your back straight.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: push-up on lower arms
instructions: Start in a plank stance with your forearms on the floor and elbows directly below your shoulders.
Activate your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Bring down your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: push-up plus
instructions: Start in a high plank stance with your hands slightly wider than about shoulder width and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bring down your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Once your chest is just above the ground, push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your upper body up.
At the top of the movement, protract your shoulder blades by pushing your upper back towards the ceiling.
Hold briefly, then reverse the movement by retracting your shoulder blades and lowering your body back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: push-up to side plank
instructions: Get into pushup position on the toes with your hands just outside of shoulder width.
Perform a pushup by allowing the elbows to flex. As you descend, keep your body straight.
Do one pushup and as you come up, shift your weight on the left side of the body, twist to the side while bringing the right arm up towards the ceiling in a side plank.
Lower the arm back to the floor for another pushup and then twist to the other side.
Repeat the series, alternating each side, for 10 or more reps.

name: quads
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width.
Bring down your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Bring down yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Push through your heels to come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: quarter sit-up
instructions: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Place your hands behind your head and lock them together by clasping your fingers. This is the starting position.
Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Breathe out when performing this part of the exercise.
Once you feel the contraction for a second, lower your upper body back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: quick feet v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and your arms by your sides.
Start by rapidly moving your feet up and down, as if you were running in place.
Keep your movements quick and light, focusing on staying on the balls of your feet.
Continue for the desired duration or number of reps.

name: raise single arm push-up
instructions: Begin laying prone on the ground. Move yourself into a position supporting your weight on your toes and one arm. Your working arm should be placed directly under the shoulder, fully extended. Your legs should be extended, and for this movement you may need a wider base, placing your feet further apart than in a normal push-up.
Maintain good posture, and place your free hand behind your back. This will be your starting position.
Lower yourself by allowing the elbow to flex until you touch the ground.
Descend slowly, and reverse direction be extending the arm to return to the starting position.
