name: rear decline bridge
instructions: Lay on your back with your feet planted on the floor and your knees bent.
Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down.
Activate your glutes and hamstrings, and lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold this stance for a few seconds, then bring down under control your hips back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: rear deltoid stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder width.
Straighten your right arm across your chest, placing your left hand on your right elbow.
Gently pull your right arm towards your left shoulder, feeling a stretch in your right shoulder.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Do it again on the other side.

name: rear pull-up
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using a wide grip.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar, bring your torso forward and head so that there is an imaginary line from the pull-up bar to the back of your neck. This is your starting position.

Pull your torso up until the bar is near the back of your neck. To do this, draw the shoulders and upper arms down and back while slightly leaning your head forward. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.
After a second on the contracted position, start to inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: reclining big toe pose with rope
instructions: Lay on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Loop the rope around the ball of your right foot and hold the ends of the rope with your hands.
Lift steadily your right leg towards your chest, while keeping your knee straight and your foot flexed.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then bring down under control your leg back down to the start stance.
Do it again with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs for your target rep count.

name: resistance band hip thrusts on knees (female)
instructions: Start by kneeling on the floor with your knees about hip width and your feet flexed.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on your hips or straighten them out in front of you for balance.
Activate your glutes and core muscles.
Push your hips forward and squeeze your glutes as you lift your knees off the ground, extending your hips until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Hold the stance for a moment, then bring down under control your knees back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: resistance band leg extension
instructions: Attach the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point and secure it around your ankle.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet about shoulder width.
While keeping your core engaged and your upper body stable, straighten your leg straight out in front of you.
Hold briefly at the top, then in a controlled manner go back your leg to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch legs.

name: resistance band seated biceps curl
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your partner standing behind you. Extend your arms straight behind you with your palms facing each other. Your partner will hold your wrists for you. This will be the starting position.
Attempt to flex your elbows, while your partner prevents any actual movement.

After 10-20 seconds, relax your arms while your partner gently pulls your wrists up to stretch your biceps. Be sure to let your partner know when the stretch is appropriate to prevent injury or overstretching.

name: resistance band seated chest press
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet planted on the floor.
Hold the resistance band handles in each hand, with your palms facing down and elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
Straighten your arms forward, pushing the resistance band away from your chest.
Hold briefly at the end of the movement, then in a controlled manner come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: resistance band seated hip abduction
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet planted on the floor.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on the sides of the chair or bench for support.
Activate your abductors (outer thigh muscles) and in a controlled manner push your knees apart, against the resistance of the band.
Hold briefly at the end of the movement, then in a controlled manner bring your knees back together.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: resistance band seated shoulder press
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet planted on the floor.
Hold the resistance band with both hands, palms facing forward, and bring it up to shoulder level.
Press the band overhead, extending your arms fully.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the band back down to shoulder level.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: resistance band seated straight back row
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop the resistance band around your feet.
Hold the ends of the resistance band with your hands, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly back, by activating your core.
Pull the resistance band towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the top, then in a controlled manner release the tension and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: reverse crunch
instructions: Lie down on the floor with your legs fully extended and arms to the side of your torso with the palms on the floor. Your arms should be stationary for the entire exercise.
Move your legs up so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and feet are together and parallel to the floor. This is the starting position.
While inhaling, move your legs towards the torso as you roll your pelvis backwards and you raise your hips off the floor. At the end of this movement your knees will be touching your chest.
Hold the contraction for a second and move your legs back to the starting position while exhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: reverse dip
instructions: Stance yourself between two parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Bring down your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Hold briefly, then push yourself back up to the start stance by straightening your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: reverse grip machine lat pulldown
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet planted on the floor.
Grip the handles with an underhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Sit upright with your chest out and shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your bring down back.
Pull the handles down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the bottom of the movement, then in a controlled manner release the handles back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: reverse grip pull-up
instructions: Take hold of the pull-up bar with an underhand grip, hands about shoulder width.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Activate your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your body back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: reverse hyper extension (on stability ball)
instructions: Lay face down on a stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your legs extended straight behind you.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you for stability.
By activating your glutes and hamstrings, lift your legs up towards the ceiling as high as you can.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your legs back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: reverse hyper on flat bench
instructions: Lay face down on a flat bench with your hips at the edge and your legs hanging off the bench.
Hold onto the bench for stability.
While keeping your legs straight, lift them up towards the ceiling as high as you can.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
Bring down under control your legs back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: reverse plank with leg lift
instructions: While standing up straight with both feet next to each other at around shoulder width, grab a sturdy surface such as the sides of a squat rack or the top of a chair to brace yourself and keep balance.
With or without an ankle weight, lift one leg behind you as if performing a leg curl but standing up while keeping the other leg straight. Breathe out as you perform this movement.
Slowly bring the raised leg back to the floor as you breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Repeat the movement with the opposite leg.

name: ring dips
instructions: Grip a ring in each hand, and then take a small jump to help you get into the starting position with your arms locked out.
Begin by flexing the elbow, lowering your body until your arms break 90 degrees. Avoid swinging, and maintain good posture throughout the descent.
Reverse the motion by extending the elbow, pushing yourself back up into the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: rocking frog stretch
instructions: Start by kneeling on the floor with your knees about hip width.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you for support.
In a controlled manner lean forward, shifting your weight onto your hands and extending your legs behind you.
Keep your back straight and activate your glutes as you push your hips back and up towards the ceiling.
Hold this stance for a few seconds, feeling a stretch in your glutes.
In a controlled manner come back to where you began by bending your knees and lowering your hips back down.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: rocky pull-up pulldown
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using a wide grip.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.

Pull your torso up until the bar touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.
After a second on the contracted position, start to inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched.

Now repeat the same movements as described above except this time your torso will remain straight as you go up and the bar will touch the back of the neck instead of the upper chest. Tip: Use the head to lean forward slightly as it will help you properly execute this portion of the exercise.
Once you have lowered yourself back down to the starting position, repeat the exercise for the prescribed amount of repetitions in your program.

name: roller back stretch
instructions: Start by sitting on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Place the roller perpendicular to your body, just below your glutes.
In a controlled manner roll your body backwards, allowing the roller to move up your back.
Continue rolling until the roller reaches your upper back.
Hold briefly, then in a controlled manner roll back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: roller body saw
instructions: Start in a plank stance with your forearms on the roller and your body in a straight line.
Activate your core and in a controlled manner roll the roller forward, extending your body as far as you can while maintaining control.
Hold briefly at the furthest point, then in a controlled manner roll the roller back towards your start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: roller hip lat stretch
instructions: Start by kneeling on the floor with the roller positioned under your hips.
Place your hands on the roller for support.
In a controlled manner roll the roller forward, extending your hips and stretching your glutes.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then roll back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: roller hip stretch
instructions: Start by sitting on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Place the roller under your glutes, just above your knees.
Lean back and place your hands on the floor behind you for support.
Activate your glutes and in a controlled manner roll the roller forward, bending your knees and bringing them towards your chest.
Hold briefly at the end of the movement, feeling a stretch in your glutes.
In a controlled manner roll the roller back to the start, extending your legs.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: roller reverse crunch
instructions: Lie down on the floor with your legs fully extended and arms to the side of your torso with the palms on the floor. Your arms should be stationary for the entire exercise.
Move your legs up so that your thighs are perpendicular to the floor and feet are together and parallel to the floor. This is the starting position.
While inhaling, move your legs towards the torso as you roll your pelvis backwards and you raise your hips off the floor. At the end of this movement your knees will be touching your chest.
Hold the contraction for a second and move your legs back to the starting position while exhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: roller seated shoulder flexor depresor retractor
instructions: Sit on a flat surface with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the roller with both hands, palms facing down, and place it on your thighs.
Lean forward slightly and roll the roller away from your body, extending your arms straight in front of you.
Hold briefly, then in a controlled manner roll the roller back towards your body, bending your arms and bringing the roller back to your thighs.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: roller seated single leg shoulder flexor depresor retractor
instructions: Sit on a flat surface with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the roller with both hands, palms facing down, and place it on your thighs.
Lean back slightly and activate your core muscles.
Lift the roller up to shoulder level, while keeping your arms straight.
Bring down under control the roller back down to your thighs.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: roller side lat stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and hold the roller with both hands in front of your body.
Flex your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, while keeping your back straight.
Straighten your arms forward and roll the roller down towards your feet, feeling a stretch in your lats.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then in a controlled manner roll the roller back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: rope climb
instructions: Grab the rope with both hands above your head. Pull down on the rope as you take a small jump.
Wrap the rope around one leg, using your feet to pinch the rope. Reach up as high as possible with your arms, gripping the rope tightly.
Release the rope from your feet as you pull yourself up with your arms, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Resecure your feet on the rope, and then stand up to take another high hold on the rope. Continue until you reach the top of the rope.
To lower yourself, loosen the grip of your feet on the rope as you slide down using a hand over hand motion.

name: run
instructions: Select a light resistance and sit down on the ab machine placing your feet under the pads provided and grabbing the top handles. Your arms should be bent at a 90 degree angle as you rest the triceps on the pads provided. This will be your starting position.

At the same time, begin to lift the legs up as you crunch your upper torso. Breathe out as you perform this movement. Tip: Be sure to use a slow and controlled motion. Concentrate on using your abs to move the weight while relaxing your legs and feet.
After a second pause, slowly return to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: run (equipment)
instructions: Start by standing upright with your feet about hip width.
Activate your core and keep your upper body relaxed.
Begin jogging in place, lifting your knees up towards your chest and landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady pace and continue jogging for the desired duration or distance.
Remember to breathe deeply and keep good posture during the exercise.

name: runners stretch
instructions: It's easiest to get into this stretch if you start standing up, put one leg behind you, and slowly lower your torso down to the floor.
Keep the front heel on the floor (if it lifts up, scoot your other leg further back).

Place your hands on either side of your front leg. To get more out of this stretch, push your butt up toward the ceiling, and then gradually lower it back toward the floor. You'll Stretch the hip flexor of the back leg and the hamstring and buttocks of the front.

name: russian twist
instructions: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.

Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Your arms should be fully extended in front of you perpendicular to your torso and with the hands clasped. This is the starting position.
Twist your torso to the right side until your arms are parallel with the floor while breathing out.
Hold the contraction for a second and move back to the starting position while breathing out. Now move to the opposite side performing the same techniques you applied to the right side.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: scapula dips
instructions: Start by standing with your feet about shoulder width and your arms extended in front of you.
Flex your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, while keeping your back straight.
Bring down your body by bending your elbows and retracting your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to squeeze a pencil between them.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your elbows and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: scapula push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank stance with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Bring down your chest towards the ground, while keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you bring down, squeeze your shoulder blades together and push your chest forward.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: scapular pull-up
instructions: Take a pronated grip on a pull-up bar.
From a hanging position, raise yourself a few inches without using your arms. Do this by depressing your shoulder girdle in a reverse shrugging motion.
Pause at the completion of the movement, and then slowly return to the starting position before performing more repetitions.

name: scissor jumps (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width.
Jump off the ground and simultaneously cross your right leg in front of your left leg.
As you land, quickly switch legs, crossing your left leg in front of your right leg.
Continue alternating legs and jumping as quickly as possible.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: seated calf stretch (male)
instructions: Sit up straight on an exercise mat.
Bend one knee and put that foot on the floor to stabilize the torso.
Straighten your other leg and flex your ankle.
Using a band, towel, or your hand if you can reach, pull the toes toward you. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, then switch sides.

name: seated glute stretch
instructions: In a seated position with your knees bent, cross one ankle over the opposite knee. Your partner will stand behind you. Now, lean forward as your partner braces your shoulders with their hands. This will be your starting position.
Attempt to push your torso back for 10-20 seconds, as your partner prevents any actual movement of your torso.
Now relax your muscles as your partner increases the stretch by gently pushing your torso forward for 10-20 seconds.

name: seated leg raise
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your back straight and your feet planted on the floor.
Place your hands on the sides of the bench for support.
While keeping your legs straight, lift steadily them up in front of you until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your legs back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: seated lower back stretch
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair with your feet planted on the floor.
Place your hands on your thighs or on the sides of the chair for support.
In a controlled manner lean forward from your hips, while keeping your back straight.
Feel the stretch in your bring down back and hold for 20-30 seconds.
In a controlled manner come back to where you began and continue for your target number of reps.

name: seated piriformis stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Flex your right knee and place your right foot on the outside of your left knee.
Place your left elbow on the outside of your right knee and gently twist your upper body to the right.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and do it again.

name: seated side crunch (wall)
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back against a wall and your legs extended in front of you.
Flex your knees and place your feet flat on the floor, about hip width.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Activate your abs and lean to one side, bringing your elbow towards your hip.
Hold briefly, then come back to where you began.
Do it again on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: seated wide angle pose sequence
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in a wide angle.
Flex your feet and activate your quadriceps.
Place your hands on the floor behind you for support.
While keeping your back straight, lean forward from your hips.
Continue leaning forward until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Hold this stance for a few breaths.
In a controlled manner release the stretch and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: self assisted inverse leg curl
instructions: Lay flat on your back on a mat or bench with your legs extended.
Place your hands by your sides or under your glutes for support.
Flex your knees and lift your feet off the ground, bringing your thighs towards your chest.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your legs back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: self assisted inverse leg curl
instructions: Lay face down on a leg curl machine with your legs extended and your ankles hooked under the padded lever.
Place your hands on the side handles of the machine for support.
While keeping your upper body stationary, breathe out and curl your legs upward as far as possible.
Hold the contracted stance for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Bring down under control your legs back to the start while inhaling.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: self assisted inverse leg curl (on floor)
instructions: Lay flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Flex your knees and place your feet planted on the floor, about hip width.
Lift your hips off the ground, by activating your glutes and hamstrings.
In a controlled manner curl your legs towards your glutes, while keeping your hips lifted.
Hold briefly at the top, then in a controlled manner straighten your legs back to the start.
Bring down your hips back down to the ground.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: semi squat jump (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width.
Flex your knees and bring down your body into a squat stance.
Jump explosively, extending your hips and knees while swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next rep.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: short stride run
instructions: Find an open space or a treadmill to do the exercise.
Stand tall with your feet about hip width.
Start jogging in place, lifting your knees high and pumping your arms.
After a few seconds, start taking short strides forward, maintaining a quick pace.
Continue running with short strides for the desired duration or distance.

name: shoulder grip pull-up
instructions: Take hold of the pull-up bar with a shoulder-width grip, palms facing away from you.
Hang freely with your arms fully extended.
Activate your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar until your chin is above the bar.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your body back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: shoulder tap
instructions: Start in a high plank stance with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Activate your core and lift your right hand off the ground, reaching across to tap your left shoulder.
Place your right hand back on the floor and do it again with your left hand tapping your right shoulder.
Continue alternating shoulder taps while while keeping your hips and upper body stable.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: shoulder tap push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank stance with your hands slightly wider than about shoulder width and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bring down your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you push back up, lift your right hand off the ground and tap your left shoulder.
Go back your right hand to the ground and do it again the push-up, this time lifting your left hand and tapping your right shoulder.
Continue alternating shoulder taps with each push-up rep.
Keep a stable core and avoid excessive hip rotation during the exercise.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: side hip (on parallel bars)
instructions: Stand between two parallel bars with your feet about shoulder width.
Place your hands on the bars and lift your body off the ground, supporting your weight on your arms.
Activate your abs and lift steadily your legs to the side, keeping them straight.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your legs back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: side hip abduction
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight to one leg and lift the opposite leg out to the side, keeping it straight.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your leg back down to the start stance.
Do it again on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: side lying floor stretch
instructions: First lie on your left side, bending your left knee in front of you to stabilize your torso (use your abdominal muscles as well to hold you upright).

Straighten your right leg and rest the right foot on the floor behind your left. Straighten your right arm over your head and gently pull on your right wrist to stretch the entire right side of the body. Switch sides.

name: side lying hip adduction (male)
instructions: Lay on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Activate your adductors and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your leg back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch sides.

name: side plank hip adduction
instructions: Get into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your toes and your forearms. Your arms are bent and directly below the shoulder.
Keep your body straight at all times, and hold this position as long as possible. To increase difficulty, an arm or leg can be raised.

name: side push neck stretch
instructions: Stand or sit up straight with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear towards your right shoulder.
Place your right hand on the left side of your head and gently apply pressure to increase the stretch.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Do it again on the other side, tilting your head to the left and applying pressure with your left hand.
Do it again the stretch 2-3 times on each side.

name: side push-up
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom hand on the floor directly under your shoulder, fingers pointing forward.
Press through your bottom hand to lift your body off the ground, while keeping your legs straight and your core engaged.
Straighten your top arm straight up towards the ceiling, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Bring down your body back down to the start stance with control.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch sides.

name: side wrist pull stretch
instructions: This stretch works best standing. Cross your left arm over the midline of your body and hold the left wrist in your right hand down at the level of your hips. Start the stretch with a bent left arm.
Slowly straighten, pull, and lift it up to shoulder height, as pictured. Feel this stretch originate in your back, not your shoulders, and don't pull too hard on the shoulders joint. Switch sides.

name: side-to-side chin
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using a wide grip.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at a wide grip, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.

Pull your torso up while leaning to the left hand side until the bar almost touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space (no swinging) and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.
After a second of contraction, inhale as you go back to the starting position.

Now, pull your torso up while leaning to the right hand side until the bar almost touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.
After a second of contraction, inhale as you go back to the starting position.
Repeat steps 3-6 until you have performed the prescribed amount of repetitions for each side.

name: side-to-side toe touch (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and your arms extended to the sides.
Flex at the waist to the right, reaching your right hand towards your right foot while while keeping your left hand extended to the side.
Come back to where you began and then flex at the waist to the left, reaching your left hand towards your left foot while while keeping your right hand extended to the side.
Do it again the side-to-side bending motion for your target rep count.

name: single arm push-up
instructions: Begin laying prone on the ground. Move yourself into a position supporting your weight on your toes and one arm. Your working arm should be placed directly under the shoulder, fully extended. Your legs should be extended, and for this movement you may need a wider base, placing your feet further apart than in a normal push-up.
Maintain good posture, and place your free hand behind your back. This will be your starting position.
Lower yourself by allowing the elbow to flex until you touch the ground.
Descend slowly, and reverse direction be extending the arm to return to the starting position.

name: single leg bridge with outstretched leg
instructions: Lay on your back with your knees bent and feet planted on the floor.
Straighten one leg straight out in front of you.
Activate your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment at the top, then bring down under control your hips back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch legs.

name: single leg calf raise (on a dumbbell)
instructions: Hang on to a sturdy object for balance and stand on a dumbbell handle, preferably one with round plates so that it rolls as in this manner you have to work harder to stabilize yourself; thus increasing the effectiveness of the exercise.
Now roll your foot slightly forward so that you can get a nice stretch of the calf. This will be your starting position.

Lift the calf as you roll your foot over the top of the handle so that you get a full extension. Exhale during the execution of this movement. Contract the calf hard at the top and hold for a second. Tip: As you come up, roll the dumbbell slightly backward.
Now inhale as you roll the dumbbell slightly forward as you come down to get a better stretch.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: single leg platform slide
instructions: Start by standing with one foot on a platform or slide board.
Flex your knee slightly and slide the foot on the platform backward, extending your leg.
Keep your core engaged and keep a straight posture through the whole movement.
In a controlled manner come back to where you began by sliding your foot back to the initial stance.
Do it again the movement for your target rep count, then switch legs.

name: single leg squat (pistol) male
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and arms extended in front of you.
Lift your right foot off the ground and straighten it forward.
Bring down under control your body down by bending your left knee and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest up and your back straight as you bring down yourself down.
Bring down until your left thigh is parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push through your left heel to come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch legs.

name: sissy squat
instructions: Standing upright, with feet at shoulder width and toes raised, use one hand to hold onto the beams of a squat rack and the opposite arm to hold a plate on top of your chest. This is your starting position.

As you use one arm to hold yourself, bend at the knees and slowly lower your torso toward the ground by bringing your pelvis and knees forward. Inhale as you go down and stop when your upper and lower legs almost create a 90-degree angle. Hold the stretch position for a second.
After your one second hold, use your thigh muscles to bring your torso back up to the starting position. Exhale as you move up.
Repeat for the recommended amount of times.

name: sit-up v. 2
instructions: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Place your hands behind your head and lock them together by clasping your fingers. This is the starting position.
Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Breathe out when performing this part of the exercise.
Once you feel the contraction for a second, lower your upper body back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: sit-up with arms on chest
instructions: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Place your hands behind your head and lock them together by clasping your fingers. This is the starting position.
Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Breathe out when performing this part of the exercise.
Once you feel the contraction for a second, lower your upper body back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: skater hops
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width.
Flex your knees slightly and jump to the right, landing on your right foot.
As you land, swing your left leg behind your right leg and tap the ground with your left toes.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot.
As you land, swing your right leg behind your left leg and tap the ground with your right toes.
Continue alternating sides, jumping and tapping the ground with each leg.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: ski ergometer
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footrests to a comfortable stance.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Sit up straight with your feet flat on the footrests.
Straighten your arms straight out in front of you, while keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Activate your triceps and push the handles down towards your thighs.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then in a controlled manner come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: ski step
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width.
Flex your knees slightly and keep your back straight.
Jump to the right, landing on your right foot while swinging your left leg behind your right leg.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot while swinging your right leg behind your left leg.
Continue alternating jumps from side to side, mimicking a skiing motion.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: skin the cat
instructions: Start by hanging from a bar with your arms fully extended and your body relaxed.
Activate your core and lift your legs up, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Continue to lift your legs up and over your head, allowing your body to pass through the arms.
Once your legs are fully extended over your head, begin to bring down them back down towards the start stance.
As you bring down your legs, allow your body to pass back through the arms until you are hanging with your arms fully extended again.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: sled 45 degrees one leg press
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock your knees. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be your starting position.
As you inhale, slowly lower the platform until your upper and lower legs make a 90-degree angle.
Pushing mainly with the heels of your feet and using the quadriceps go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and ensure to lock the safety pins properly once you are done. You do not want that platform falling on you fully loaded.

name: sled 45в° calf press
instructions: Adjust the seat so that your legs are only slightly bent in the start position. The balls of your feet should be firmly on the platform.
Select an appropriate weight, and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.

Straighten the legs by extending the knees, just barely lifting the weight from the stack. Your ankle should be fully flexed, toes pointing up. Execute the movement by pressing downward through the balls of your feet as far as possible.
After a brief pause, reverse the motion and repeat.

name: sled 45в° leg press
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock your knees. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be your starting position.
As you inhale, slowly lower the platform until your upper and lower legs make a 90-degree angle.
Pushing mainly with the heels of your feet and using the quadriceps go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and ensure to lock the safety pins properly once you are done. You do not want that platform falling on you fully loaded.

name: sled 45в° leg press (back pov)
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

name: sled 45° leg press (side pov)
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock your knees. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be your starting position.
As you inhale, slowly lower the platform until your upper and lower legs make a 90-degree angle.
Pushing mainly with the heels of your feet and using the quadriceps go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and ensure to lock the safety pins properly once you are done. You do not want that platform falling on you fully loaded.

name: sled 45в° leg wide press
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the foot platform.
Stance your feet wider than about shoulder width.
Push against the foot platform to straighten your legs and straighten your knees.
Hold briefly at the end of the movement, then in a controlled manner flex your knees to come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: sled calf press on leg press
instructions: Adjust the seat so that your legs are only slightly bent in the start position. The balls of your feet should be firmly on the platform.
Select an appropriate weight, and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.

Straighten the legs by extending the knees, just barely lifting the weight from the stack. Your ankle should be fully flexed, toes pointing up. Execute the movement by pressing downward through the balls of your feet as far as possible.
After a brief pause, reverse the motion and repeat.

name: sled closer hack squat
instructions: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.
Position your legs in the platform using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
Place your arms on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front position to a diagonal position).

Now straighten your legs without locking the knees. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the unit by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the unit as you exhale by pushing the floor with mainly with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: sled forward angled calf raise
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight and stance yourself on the machine with your toes on the platform and your heels hanging off.
Place your hands on the handles or the sides of the machine for support.
Activate your calves and lift steadily your heels as high as possible, pushing against the resistance of the sled.
Hold briefly at the top of the movement, then bring down under control your heels back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: sled hack squat
instructions: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.
Position your legs in the platform using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
Place your arms on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front position to a diagonal position).

Now straighten your legs without locking the knees. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the unit by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the unit as you exhale by pushing the floor with mainly with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: sled lying calf press
instructions: Adjust the seat so that your legs are only slightly bent in the start position. The balls of your feet should be firmly on the platform.
Select an appropriate weight, and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.

Straighten the legs by extending the knees, just barely lifting the weight from the stack. Your ankle should be fully flexed, toes pointing up. Execute the movement by pressing downward through the balls of your feet as far as possible.
After a brief pause, reverse the motion and repeat.

name: sled lying squat
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Lay on your back on the sled machine with your feet on the footplate.
Stance your feet about shoulder width and slightly angled outwards.
Grip the handles of the sled machine for stability.
Activate your glutes and core muscles.
Push through your heels and straighten your legs to lift the sled.
Bring down the sled back down by bending your knees and hips.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: sled one leg calf press on leg press
instructions: Adjust the seat so that your legs are only slightly bent in the start position. The balls of your feet should be firmly on the platform.
Select an appropriate weight, and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.

Straighten the legs by extending the knees, just barely lifting the weight from the stack. Your ankle should be fully flexed, toes pointing up. Execute the movement by pressing downward through the balls of your feet as far as possible.
After a brief pause, reverse the motion and repeat.

name: sledge hammer
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and hold the sledge hammer with both hands.
Activate your core and keep your back straight.
Swing the sledge hammer down towards the ground, using your core and upper body strength.
As you swing down, pivot your hips and transfer the force to the hammer.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith back shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and your knees slightly bent.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Keep your arms straight and allow the barbell to hang in front of your thighs.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold for a moment, then bring down your shoulders back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith behind neck press
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench. Using a medium-width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over your neck with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your neck.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up).
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.

name: smith bench press
instructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to chest level.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the floor.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Unrack the bar and bring down it towards your chest, while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Hold briefly when the bar touches your chest.
Push the bar back up to the start stance, fully extending your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith bent knee good morning
instructions: Begin with a bar on a rack at shoulder height. Rack the bar across the rear of your shoulders as you would a power squat, not on top of your shoulders. Keep your back tight, shoulder blades pinched together, and your knees slightly bent. Step back from the rack.
Begin by bending at the hips, moving them back as you bend over to near parallel. Keep your back arched and your cervical spine in proper alignment.
Reverse the motion by extending through the hips with your glutes and hamstrings. Continue until you have returned to the starting position.

name: smith bent over row
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
Stand facing the bar with your feet about shoulder width.
Flex your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, while keeping your back straight.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Pull the bar towards your bring down chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the bar back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith chair squat
instructions: To begin, first set the bar to a position that best matches your height. Once the bar is loaded, step under it and position it across the back of your shoulders.
Take the bar with your hands facing forward, unlock it and lift it off the rack by extending your legs.

Move your feet forward about 18 inches in front of the bar. Position your legs using a shoulder width stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Look forward at all times and maintain a neutral or slightly arched spine. This will be your starting position.
Slowly lower the bar by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper and lower leg breaks 90 degrees.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heels of your feet, extending the knees and returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: smith close-grip bench press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the bench with your feet planted on the floor.
Grip the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than about shoulder width.
Bring down the barbell towards your chest, while keeping your elbows close to your body.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith deadlift
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
Stand with your feet about shoulder width, toes pointing slightly outward.
Flex at the hips and knees, while keeping your back straight and chest up, and grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Activate your core and lift the bar by extending your hips and knees, keeping the bar close to your body.
Stand tall, fully extending your hips and knees.
Bring down the bar back down by bending at the hips and knees, maintaining control and while keeping your back straight.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith decline bench press
instructions: Adjust the decline bench to the desired angle.
Lay down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Unrack the barbell and bring down it in a controlled manner towards your chest, while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith decline reverse-grip press
instructions: Adjust the smith machine to a decline stance.
Lay down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grip the barbell with a reverse grip, hands slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Unrack the barbell and bring down it towards your chest, while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith front squat (clean grip)
instructions: With a barbell on the floor close to the shins, take an overhand (or hook) grip just outside the legs. Lower your hips with the weight focused on the heels, back straight, head facing forward, chest up, with your shoulders just in front of the bar. This will be your starting position.

Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending your knees. Your back angle should stay the same, and your arms should remain straight. Move the weight with control as you continue to above the knees.

Next comes the second pull, the main source of acceleration for the clean. As the bar approaches the mid-thigh position, begin extending through the hips. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending the hips, knees, and ankles, using speed to move the bar upward. There should be no need to actively pull through the arms to accelerate the weight; at the end of the second pull, the body should be fully extended, leaning slightly back, with the arms still extended.

As full extension is achieved, transition into the third pull by aggressively shrugging and flexing the arms with the elbows up and out. At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating your elbows under the bar as you do so. Receive the bar in a front squat position, the depth of which is dependent upon the height of the bar at the end of the third pull. The bar should be racked onto the protracted shoulders, lightly touching the throat with the hands relaxed. Continue to descend to the bottom squat position, which will help in the recovery.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, keeping the torso upright and elbows up. Continue until you have risen to a standing position.

name: smith full squat
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at shoulder height.
Stand with your feet about shoulder width, toes slightly turned out.
Step under the bar and stance it across your upper back, resting on your traps.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Unrack the bar and take a step back, maintaining a stable stance.
While keeping your chest up and core engaged, initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Bring down your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as your flexibility allows.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then drive through your heels to come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith hack squat
instructions: Place the back of your torso against the back pad of the machine and hook your shoulders under the shoulder pads provided.
Position your legs in the platform using a shoulder width medium stance with the toes slightly pointed out. Tip: Keep your head up at all times and also maintain the back on the pad at all times.
Place your arms on the side handles of the machine and disengage the safety bars (which on most designs is done by moving the side handles from a facing front position to a diagonal position).

Now straighten your legs without locking the knees. This will be your starting position. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Begin to slowly lower the unit by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up (back on the pad at all times). Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the unit as you exhale by pushing the floor with mainly with the heel of your foot as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: smith hip raise
instructions: Stance yourself on the smith machine with your back against the pad and your feet about shoulder width.
Place your hands on the barbell, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Activate your core and glutes, then push through your heels to lift your hips off the ground.
Continue lifting until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment at the top, then bring down under control your hips back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith incline bench press
instructions: Adjust the bench to a 30-45 degree incline.
Sit on the bench with your back flat against the pad and feet firmly on the floor.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Unrack the barbell and bring down it in a controlled manner towards your upper chest, while keeping your elbows slightly tucked in.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the start stance, fully extending your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith incline reverse-grip press
instructions: Adjust the seat of the smith machine to a comfortable incline angle.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet planted on the floor.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip that is slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Unrack the bar and bring down it in a controlled manner towards your chest, while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Hold briefly when the bar is just above your chest.
Push the bar back up to the start stance, fully extending your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith incline shoulder raises
instructions: Place an incline bench underneath the smith machine. Place the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and your arms are almost fully extended. Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the incline bench and make sure your shoulders are aligned right under the barbell.
Using a shoulder width pronated (palms forward) grip, lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with a slight bend at the elbows. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe out, lift the bar up until your arms are fully extended. Note: The contraction should be felt around the shoulders.
After a second pause, bring the bar back down to the starting position as you breathe in.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.

name: smith leg press
instructions: Using a leg press machine, sit down on the machine and place your legs on the platform directly in front of you at a medium (shoulder width) foot stance. (Note: For the purposes of this discussion we will use the medium stance described above which targets overall development; however you can choose any of the three stances described in the foot positioning section).

Lower the safety bars holding the weighted platform in place and press the platform all the way up until your legs are fully extended in front of you. Tip: Make sure that you do not lock your knees. Your torso and the legs should make a perfect 90-degree angle. This will be your starting position.
As you inhale, slowly lower the platform until your upper and lower legs make a 90-degree angle.
Pushing mainly with the heels of your feet and using the quadriceps go back to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions and ensure to lock the safety pins properly once you are done. You do not want that platform falling on you fully loaded.

name: smith low bar squat
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at a height that allows you to comfortably rest it on your upper back.
Stand with your feet about shoulder width, toes slightly turned outwards.
Step under the bar and stance it across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Unrack the bar by straightening your legs and stepping back from the rack.
Take a deep breath and brace your core.
Initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Bring down your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Keep your chest up and your back straight through the whole movement.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith machine bicep curl
instructions: Adjust the seat to the appropriate height and make your weight selection. Place your upper arms against the pads and grasp the handles. This will be your starting position.
Perform the movement by flexing the elbow, pulling your lower arm towards your upper arm.
Pause at the top of the movement, and then slowly return the weight to the starting position.
Avoid returning the weight all the way to the stops until the set is complete to keep tension on the muscles being worked.

name: smith machine decline close grip bench press
instructions: Place a flat bench underneath the smith machine. Place the barbell at a height that you can reach when lying down and your arms are almost fully extended. Once the weight you need is selected, lie down on the flat bench. Using a close and pronated grip (palms facing forward) that is around shoulder width, unlock the bar from the rack and hold it straight over you with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.

As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your middle chest. Tip: Make sure that as opposed to a regular bench press, you keep the elbows close to the torso at all times in order to maximize triceps involvement.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your triceps muscles. Lock your arms in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up.
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, lock the bar back in the rack.

name: smith machine incline tricep extension
instructions: Adjust the seat of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder height.
Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and your feet planted on the floor.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Straighten your arms fully, lifting the bar off the rack and holding it directly above your chest.
Bring down the bar in a controlled manner towards your forehead, while keeping your elbows close to your head.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push the bar back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith machine reverse decline close grip bench press
instructions: Adjust the smith machine to a decline stance.
Lay down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grip the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than about shoulder width.
Unrack the barbell and bring down it in a controlled manner towards your chest, while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith narrow row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip, slightly narrower than about shoulder width.
Keep your back straight and your chest up as you pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the peak of the movement, then in a controlled manner release the handles back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith one arm row
instructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to waist level.
Stand facing the smith machine with your feet about shoulder width.
Flex your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, while keeping your back straight.
Grip the bar with one hand using an overhand grip, with your palm facing down.
Keep your elbow close to your body and pull the bar towards your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the top of the movement, then bring down under control the bar back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch to the other arm.

name: smith one leg floor calf raise
instructions: Stance yourself on the floor under the smith machine bar, facing away from the machine.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised surface, such as a weight plate or block.
Stance the smith machine bar across your bring down legs, just above your ankles.
Hold onto the bar with your hands for stability.
Lift your heels off the ground by extending your ankles, lifting your body up.
Pause at the top of the movement, then bring down under control your heels back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith rear delt row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet planted on the floor.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged as you pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the top of the movement, then in a controlled manner release the handles back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith reverse calf raises
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height just below your shoulders.
Stand facing the bar with your feet about hip width and toes pointing forward.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or platform, with your heels hanging off.
Hold onto the bar for support, while keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Lift your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your heels back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith reverse calf raises
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height just below your shoulders.
Stand facing the bar with your feet about hip width and toes pointing forward.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or platform, with your heels hanging off.
Hold onto the bar for support.
Lift your heels as high as possible, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your heels back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith reverse grip bent over row
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
Stand facing the bar with your feet about shoulder width.
Flex your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, while keeping your back straight.
Grip the bar with an underhand grip, hands about shoulder width.
Pull the bar towards your bring down chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the bar back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith reverse-grip press
instructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to chest level.
Stand facing the bar with your feet about shoulder width.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Step back and stance yourself with a slight flex in your knees.
Keep your chest up and core engaged during the exercise.
Bring down the bar towards your chest, while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push the bar back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith seated one leg calf raise
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the footrest.
Place one leg on the footrest and keep the other leg off the footrest.
Using your calf muscles, lift your heel as high as possible.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your heel back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch legs and do it again.

name: smith seated shoulder press
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that the handles are at shoulder level.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip and lift them off the supports, extending your arms fully.
Bring down the handles down to shoulder level, while keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Press the handles up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the handles back down to shoulder level.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith seated wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench in front of a Smith machine with your feet planted on the floor.
Grip the barbell with an underhand grip, hands about shoulder width.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off.
In a controlled manner curl your wrists upward, bringing the barbell towards your forearms.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the barbell back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith shoulder press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself on the smith machine with your feet about shoulder width.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Lift the bar off the rack and stance it at shoulder level, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the bar upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the bar back down to shoulder level.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and your knees slightly bent.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulders up towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold for a moment, then bring down under control your shoulders back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith single leg split squat
instructions: To begin, place a flat bench 2-3 feet behind the smith machine. Then, set the bar on the height that best matches your height. Once the correct height is chosen and the bar is loaded, step under the bar and place the back of your shoulders (slightly below the neck) across it.
Hold on to the bar using both arms at each side (palms facing forward), unlock it and lift it off the rack by first pushing with your legs and at the same time straightening your torso.
Position your legs by placing one foot slightly forward under the bar and extending your other leg back and place the top of your foot on the bench. This will be your starting position

Begin to slowly lower the bar by bending the knee as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calf becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knee should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that is perpendicular to the front. If your knee is past that imaginary line (if it is past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.
Begin to raise the bar as you exhale by pushing the floor with the heel of your foot mainly as you straighten your leg again and go back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
Switch legs and repeat the movement.

name: smith sprint lunge
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at hip height.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet about shoulder width.
Step back with your right foot and place it on the barbell, resting the top of your foot on the bar.
Flex your left knee and bring down your body into a lunge stance, while keeping your back straight.
Push through your left heel to come back to where you began.
Do it again on the other side, stepping back with your left foot.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: smith squat
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at an appropriate height for your squat.
Stand with your feet about shoulder width, toes slightly turned out.
Stance yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper traps and shoulders.
Grip the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Activate your core and unrack the barbell, stepping back to clear the rack.
While keeping your chest up and back straight, initiate the squat by bending at the hips and knees.
Bring down your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then drive through your heels to come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith standing back wrist curl
instructions: Stand facing the smith machine with your feet about shoulder width.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder width.
Keep your back straight and your elbows close to your body.
In a controlled manner curl your wrists upwards, bringing the barbell towards your body.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the barbell back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith standing behind head military press
instructions: Adjust the seat height of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder level.
Stand with your feet about shoulder width and your knees slightly bent.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Lift the bar off the rack and step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Stance the bar behind your head, resting on your upper traps.
Keep your core engaged and your chest lifted during the exercise.
Press the bar overhead by extending your arms, fully straightening them.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then bring down under control the bar back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith standing leg calf raise
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to stand with your feet planted on the floor and your shoulders under the bar.
Stance yourself under the bar with your feet about shoulder width and your toes pointing forward.
