Place your hands on the bar for stability.
Activate your calves and lift steadily your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your heels back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith standing military press
instructions: Start by placing a barbell that is about chest high on a squat rack. Once you have selected the weights, grab the barbell using a pronated (palms facing forward) grip. Make sure to grip the bar wider than shoulder width apart from each other.
Slightly bend the knees and place the barbell on your collar bone. Lift the barbell up keeping it lying on your chest. Take a step back and position your feet shoulder width apart from each other.

Once you pick up the barbell with the correct grip length, lift the bar up over your head by locking your arms. Hold at about shoulder level and slightly in front of your head. This is your starting position.
Lower the bar down to the collarbone slowly as you inhale.
Lift the bar back up to the starting position as you exhale.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: smith sumo squat
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at hip height.
Stand with your feet wider than about shoulder width, toes pointing outwards.
Stance yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper back and shoulders.
Activate your core and keep your chest up as you bring down your body down into a squat stance, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Bring down yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push through your heels to come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith toe raise
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to comfortably stand with your feet planted on the floor.
Stance yourself under the bar with your shoulders directly below it and your feet about shoulder width.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised platform or weight plates, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Activate your core and keep your back straight during the exercise.
Lift steadily your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your heels back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith upright row
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width, facing the smith machine.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the barbell up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control the barbell back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith wide grip bench press
instructions: Adjust the bench to a comfortable stance on the smith machine.
Lay down on the bench with your feet planted on the floor.
Grip the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Unrack the barbell and bring down it in a controlled manner towards your chest, while keeping your elbows out to the sides.
Hold briefly when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the start stance, fully extending your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: smith wide grip decline bench press
instructions: Adjust the decline bench to the desired angle.
Lay down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grip the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Unrack the barbell and bring down it in a controlled manner towards your chest, while keeping your elbows pointed outwards.
Hold briefly when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the start stance, fully extending your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: snatch pull
instructions: With a barbell on the floor close to the shins, take a wide snatch grip. Lower your hips with the weight focused on the heels, back straight, head facing forward, chest up, with your shoulders just in front of the bar. This will be your starting position.

Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending your knees. Your back angle should stay the same, and your arms should remain straight. Move the weight with control as you continue to above the knees.

Next comes the second pull, the main source of acceleration for the pull. As the bar approaches the mid-thigh position, begin extending through the hips. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending the hips, knees, and ankles, using speed to move the bar upward.

There should be no need to actively pull through the arms to accelerate the weight; at the end of the second pull, the body should be fully extended, leaning slightly back. Full extension should be violent and abrupt, and ensure that you do not prolong the extension for longer than necessary.

name: spell caster
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a pronated grip. Your feet should be wide with your hips and knees extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by pulling both of the dumbbells to one side next to your hip, rotating your torso.
Keeping your arms straight and the dumbbells parallel to the ground, rotate your torso to swing the weights to your opposite side.
Continue alternating, rotating from one side to the other until the set is complete.

name: sphinx
instructions: Lay face down on the floor with your forearms flat on the floor, elbows directly under your shoulders.
Activate your core and lift your chest off the ground, while keeping your forearms and toes on the floor.
Hold this stance for a few seconds, making sure to keep your neck in a neutral stance.
Bring down under control your chest back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: spider crawl push up
instructions: Begin in a prone position on the floor. Support your weight on your hands and toes, with your feet together and your body straight. Your arms should be bent to 90 degrees. This will be your starting position.
Initiate the movement by raising one foot off of the ground. Externally rotate the leg and bring the knee toward your elbow, as far forward as possible.
Return this leg to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

name: spine stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Place your hands on the floor behind you, fingers pointing towards your body.
Activate your core and in a controlled manner lean back, while keeping your back straight.
Continue leaning back until you feel a stretch in your spine.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then in a controlled manner come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: spine twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Flex your knees and place your feet planted on the floor, about hip width.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Activate your abs and in a controlled manner twist your upper body to the right, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
Hold briefly at the end of the twist, then in a controlled manner come back to where you began.
Do it again the twist to the left side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: split squats
instructions: Being in a standing position. Jump into a split leg position, with one leg forward and one leg back, flexing the knees and lowering your hips slightly as you do so.
As you descend, immediately reverse direction, standing back up and jumping, reversing the position of your legs. Repeat 5-10 times on each leg.

name: squat jerk
instructions: Standing with the weight racked on the front of the shoulders, begin with the dip. With your feet directly under your hips, flex the knees without moving the hips backward. Go down only slightly, and reverse direction as powerfully as possible. Drive through the heels create as much speed and force as possible, and be sure to move your head out of the way as the bar leaves the shoulders.

At this moment as the feet leave the floor, the feet must be placed into the receiving position as quickly as possible. In the brief moment the feet are not actively driving against the platform, the athlete's effort to push the bar up will drive them down. The feet should move forcefully to just outside the hips, turned out as necessary. Receive the bar with your body in a full squat and the arms fully extended overhead.
Keeping the bar aligned over the front of the heels, your head and chest up, drive throught heels of the feet to move to a standing position. Carefully return the weight to floor.

name: squat on bosu ball
instructions: Place the bosu ball on the floor with the flat side up.
Stand with your feet about shoulder width and stance yourself on top of the bosu ball.
Bring down your body down by bending your knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your weight on your heels.
Bring down yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Hold briefly, then push through your heels to come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: squat to overhead reach
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and toes slightly turned out.
Bring down your body down into a squat stance by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you come up from the squat, straighten your arms overhead, reaching towards the ceiling.
Come back to where you began by lowering your arms and bending your knees to squat down again.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: squat to overhead reach with twist
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and toes slightly turned out.
Bring down your body into a squat stance by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you come up from the squat, lift your arms overhead and twist your upper body to one side.
Come back to where you began and do it again the squat, this time twisting your upper body to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides with each squat rep.

name: stability ball crunch (full range hands behind head)
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet planted on the floor and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
By activating your abs, in a controlled manner curl your upper body forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your upper body back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: stalder press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet about shoulder width and your arms extended overhead.
Flex your knees slightly and activate your core.
Bring down your body down into a squat stance while while keeping your arms extended overhead.
As you squat down, press your arms down towards the ground, by activating your triceps.
Hold briefly at the bottom of the squat, then push through your heels to stand back up while simultaneously raising your arms back overhead.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: standing archer
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and your knees slightly bent.
Straighten your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, parallel to the ground.
Rotate your upper body to the right, while keeping your arms extended and your back straight.
As you rotate, straighten your right arm forward and your left arm back, mimicking the motion of drawing a bowstring.
Hold the stance for a moment, then come back to where you began.
Do it again the motion, this time rotating your upper body to the left and extending your left arm forward and your right arm back.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: standing behind neck press
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench. Using a medium-width grip (a grip that creates a 90-degree angle in the middle of the movement between the forearms and the upper arms), lift the bar from the rack and hold it straight over your neck with your arms locked. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, come down slowly until you feel the bar on your neck.

After a second pause, bring the bar back to the starting position as you breathe out and push the bar using your chest muscles. Lock your arms and squeeze your chest in the contracted position, hold for a second and then start coming down slowly again. Tip: It should take at least twice as long to go down than to come up).
Repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
When you are done, place the bar back in the rack.

name: standing calf raise (on a staircase)
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step or a sturdy platform with your heels hanging off and your toes on the step.
Hold onto a railing or wall for balance if needed.
Lift steadily your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your heels back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: standing calves
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width, toes pointing forward.
Lift your heels off the ground as high as possible, standing on your toes.
Hold the stance for a moment, then bring down under control your heels back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: standing calves calf stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall or sturdy object, about an arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall or object at shoulder height.
Step back with one foot, while keeping your heel flat on the floor.
Flex your front knee slightly and lean forward, while keeping your back leg straight.
You should feel a stretch in your calf muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Do it again on the other leg.

name: standing hamstring and calf stretch with strap
instructions: Being by looping a belt, band, or rope around one foot. While standing, place that foot forward.
Bend your back leg, while keeping the front one straight. Now raise the toes of your front foot off of the ground and lean forward.
Using the belt, pull on the top of the foot to increase the stretch in the calf. Hold for 10-20 seconds and repeat with the other foot.

name: standing lateral stretch
instructions: Take a slightly wider than hip distance stance with your knees slightly bent.
Place your right hand on your right hip to support the spine.
Raise your left arm in a vertical line and place your left hand behind your head. Keep it there as you incline your torso to the right.
Keep your weight evenly distributed between both legs (don't lean into your left hip). Switch sides.

name: standing pelvic tilt
instructions: Start off with your feet hip-distance apart.
Bend your knees slightly to keep them soft and springy.
You may want to move your pelvis forward and backward and back few times before holding the tailbone forward in this stretch.

name: standing single leg curl
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip width and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot off the ground, bending your knee.
In a controlled manner curl your right heel towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstring.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your right foot back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch legs.

name: standing wheel rollerout
instructions: Start by standing tall with your feet about shoulder width and the wheel roller in front of you.
Flex at your waist and in a controlled manner roll the wheel forward, while keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Continue rolling forward until you feel a stretch in your abs and your body is extended as far as possible.
Hold briefly, then in a controlled manner roll the wheel back towards your body, returning to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: star jump (male)
instructions: Begin in a relaxed stance with your feet shoulder width apart and hold your arms close to the body.
To initiate the move, squat down halfway and explode back up as high as possible. Fully extend your entire body, spreading your legs and arms away from the body.
As you land, bring your limbs back in and absorb your impact through the legs.

name: stationary bike run v. 3
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance to ensure proper alignment.
Place your feet on the pedals and secure them with the straps if available.
Start pedaling at a comfortable pace.
Keep a steady rhythm and increase the resistance as desired.
Activate your core muscles to keep stability and proper posture.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your workout.
Gradually decrease the resistance and slow down before coming to a complete stop.
Stretch your legs and cool down after the workout.

name: stationary bike walk
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance on the stationary bike to ensure proper alignment.
Place your feet on the pedals and secure them with the straps if available.
Start pedaling at a comfortable pace, while keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Keep a steady rhythm and increase the resistance level if desired.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
Cool down by gradually reducing your pace and resistance level.
Stretch your leg muscles after the workout to prevent tightness and promote recovery.

name: straddle maltese
instructions: Start by hanging from a pair of rings with your arms fully extended and your body in a straight line.
Spread your legs wide apart, forming a straddle stance.
Activate your core and bring down under control your body until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Hold this stance for a few seconds, then push yourself back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: straddle planche
instructions: Start in a push-up stance with your hands about shoulder width and your feet spread wide apart.
Activate your core and in a controlled manner shift your weight forward, bringing your shoulders over your hands.
Flex your elbows and bring down your body towards the ground, while keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: straight leg outer hip abductor
instructions: Lay on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Activate your core and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your leg back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch sides.

name: superman push-up
instructions: To begin, lie straight and face down on the floor or exercise mat. Your arms should be fully extended in front of you. This is the starting position.

Simultaneously raise your arms, legs, and chest off of the floor and hold this contraction for 2 seconds. Tip: Squeeze your lower back to get the best results from this exercise. Remember to exhale during this movement. Note: When holding the contracted position, you should look like superman when he is flying.
Slowly begin to lower your arms, legs and chest back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions prescribed in your program.

name: suspended abdominal fallout
instructions: Attach a suspension trainer to a high anchor point and adjust the straps to waist height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point and hold the handles with your arms extended in front of you.
Lean forward at the waist, while keeping your body straight and your core engaged.
Bring down your body as far as you can while maintaining control and tension in your abs.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then lift steadily your body back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: suspended push-up
instructions: Anchor your suspension straps securely to the top of a rack or other object.

Leaning into the straps, take a handle in each hand and move into a push-up plank position. You should be as close to parallel to the ground as you can manage with your arms fully extended, maintaining good posture.
Maintaining a straight, rigid torso, descend slowly by allowing the elbows to flex.
Continue until your elbows break 90 degrees, pausing before you extend to return to the starting position.

name: suspended reverse crunch
instructions: Secure a set of suspension straps with the handles hanging about a foot off of the ground. Move yourself into a pushup plank position facing away from the rack.
Place your feet into the handles. You should maintain a straight posture, not allowing the hips to sag. This will be your starting position.
Begin the movement by flexing the knees and hips, drawing the knees to your torso. As you do so, anteriorly tilt your pelvis, allowing your spine to flex.
At the top of the controlled motion, return to the starting position.

name: suspended row
instructions: Suspend your straps at around chest height. Take a handle in each hand and lean back. Keep your body erect and your head and chest up. Your arms should be fully extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin by flexing the elbow to initiate the movement. Protract your shoulder blades as you do so.
At the completion of the motion pause, and then return to the starting position.

name: suspended split squat
instructions: Suspend your straps so the handles are 18-30 inches from the floor.
Facing away from the setup, place your rear foot into the handle behind you. Keep your head looking forward and your chest up, with your knee slightly bent. This will be your starting position.
Descend by flexing the knee and hips, lowering yourself to the ground. Keep your weight on the heel of your foot and maintain your posture throughout the exercise.
At the bottom of the movement, reverse the motion, extending through the hip and knee to return to the starting position.

name: swimmer kicks v. 2 (male)
instructions: Lay face down on a mat with your arms extended overhead.
Activate your core and lift your chest and legs off the ground simultaneously.
Kick your legs up and down in a fluttering motion, as if you were swimming.
Continue kicking for your target rep count.
Bring down your chest and legs back down to the start stance.

name: swing 360
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and knees slightly bent.
Hold your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Activate your core and swing your arms in a circular motion, rotating your upper body as you do so.
Continue the circular motion, swinging your arms and rotating your upper body for your target rep count.
Remember to breathe during the exercise.

name: three bench dip
instructions: Sit on a bench with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Flex your elbows and bring down your body until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Push yourself back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: tire flip
instructions: Begin by gripping the bottom of the tire on the tread, and position your feet back a bit. Your chest should be driving into the tire.
To lift the tire, extend through the hips, knees, and ankles, driving into the tire and up.

As the tire reaches a 45 degree angle, step forward and drive a knee into the tire. As you do so adjust your grip to the upper portion of the tire and push it forward as hard as possible to complete the turn. Repeat as necessary.

name: trap bar deadlift
instructions: For this exercise load a trap bar, also known as a hex bar, to an appropriate weight resting on the ground. Stand in the center of the apparatus and grasp both handles.
Lower your hips, look forward with your head and keep your chest up.
Begin the movement by driving through the heels and extend your hips and knees. Avoid rounding your back at all times.
At the completion of the movement, lower the weight back to the ground under control.

name: triceps dip
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Flex your elbows and bring down your body towards the ground, while keeping your back close to the bench.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: triceps dip (bench leg)
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Walk your feet forward, sliding your butt off the bench, and straighten your arms.
Flex your elbows and bring down your body towards the ground, while keeping your back close to the bench.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: triceps dip (between benches)
instructions: Sit on a bench with your hands gripping the edge of the bench, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Flex your elbows and bring down your body towards the ground, while keeping your back close to the bench.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: triceps dips floor
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair or bench with your hands next to your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the front of the chair with your legs extended in front of you.
Straighten your arms, keeping a little flex in your elbows to keep tension on your triceps and off your elbow joints.
In a controlled manner flex your elbows to bring down your body toward the floor until your elbows are at about a 90-degree angle.
Once you reach the bottom of the movement, press down into the chair to straighten your elbows, returning to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: triceps press
instructions: While holding a barbell or EZ Curl bar with a pronated grip (palms facing forward), lie on your back on a flat bench with your head off the end of the bench. Tip: If you are holding a barbell grab it using a shoulder-width grip and if you are using an E-Z Bar grab it on the inner handles.
Extend your arms in front of you as you hold the barbell over your chest. The arms should be perpendicular to your torso (90-degree angle). This will be your starting position.
As you inhale, lower the bar in a semi-circular motion by bending at the elbows and while keeping the upper arm stationary and elbows in. Keep lowering the bar until it lightly touches your chin.

As you exhale bring the bar back up to the starting position by pushing the bar up in a semi-circular motion. Contract the triceps hard at the top of the movement for a second. Tip: Again, only the forearms should move. The upper arms should remain stationary at all times.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: triceps stretch
instructions: Reach your hand behind your head, grasp your elbow and gently pull. Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, then switch sides.

name: tuck crunch
instructions: To begin, lie down on the floor or an exercise mat with your back pressed against the floor. Your arms should be lying across your sides with the palms facing down.

Your legs should be crossed by wrapping one ankle around the other. Slowly elevate your legs up in the air until your thighs are perpendicular to the floor with a slight bend at the knees. Note: Your knees and toes should be parallel to the floor as opposed to the thighs.
Move your arms from the floor and cross them so they are resting on your chest. This is the starting position.
While keeping your lower back pressed against the floor, slowly lift your torso. Remember to exhale while perform this part of the exercise.
Slowly begin to lower your torso back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: twin handle parallel grip lat pulldown
instructions: Adjust the seat height and stance yourself facing the cable machine.
Grip the handles with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder width.
Sit down and stance your thighs under the thigh pads, while keeping your feet flat on the floor.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up, maintaining a neutral spine.
Pull the handles down towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold briefly at the bottom of the movement, feeling the contraction in your lats.
In a controlled manner release the handles and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: twist hip lift
instructions: Lay on your back with your knees bent and feet planted on the floor.
Place your hands by your sides for support.
Activate your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
While while keeping your hips lifted, twist your bring down body to the right side, bringing your knees towards the ground.
Come back to where you began and do it again the twist to the left side.
Continue alternating twists for your target rep count.

name: twisted leg raise
instructions: Lay flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Activate your abs and lift both legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
As you lift your legs, twist your hips to one side, bringing your legs towards your opposite shoulder.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your legs back down to the start stance.
Do it again the movement, this time twisting your hips to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: twisted leg raise (female)
instructions: Lay flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Flex your knees and lift your legs off the ground, bringing them towards your chest.
As you lift your legs, twist your hips to one side, bringing your knees towards your opposite shoulder.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your legs back down to the start stance.
Do it again the movement, this time twisting your hips to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: two toe touch (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and your arms extended out to the sides.
Flex forward at the waist, while keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with both hands, while keeping your legs straight.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then in a controlled manner come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: upper back stretch
instructions: Clasp fingers together with your thumbs pointing down, round your shoulders as you reach your hands forward.

name: upward facing dog
instructions: Lay face down on the floor with your legs extended behind you.
Place your hands on the floor next to your bring down ribs, fingers pointing forward.
Press your hands firmly into the floor and straighten your arms, lifting your upper body and thighs off the ground.
Roll your shoulders back and down, opening your chest and lifting your gaze towards the ceiling.
Hold this stance for a few breaths, then bring down under control your body back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: v-sit on floor
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Lean back slightly and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Simultaneously, lift your upper body off the ground and reach your arms towards your legs.
Hold this stance for a few seconds, then bring down under control your upper body and legs back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: vertical leg raise (on parallel bars)
instructions: Hang from the parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Activate your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or slightly higher.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your legs back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: walk elliptical cross trainer
instructions: Adjust the resistance level and incline of the elliptical machine to your desired settings.
Step onto the pedals of the machine and grip the handles lightly.
Start by pushing down with your feet and pulling the handles towards your body.
Continue this motion, alternating between pushing and pulling, to simulate a walking or running motion.
Keep a steady pace and keep your core engaged during the exercise.
Continue for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
Gradually decrease the intensity and speed of the machine before stepping off.

name: walking high knees lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip width.
Lift your right knee up towards your chest as high as you can while balancing on your left leg.
Step forward with your right foot and bring down your body into a lunge stance, bending both knees to a 90-degree angle.
Push off with your right foot and bring your left knee up towards your chest.
Step forward with your left foot and bring down your body into a lunge stance.
Continue alternating legs and lunging forward, while keeping your core engaged and maintaining a steady pace.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: walking lunge
instructions: Begin standing with your feet shoulder width apart and a barbell across your upper back.

Step forward with one leg, flexing the knees to drop your hips. Descend until your rear knee nearly touches the ground. Your posture should remain upright, and your front knee should stay above the front foot.
Drive through the heel of your lead foot and extend both knees to raise yourself back up.
Step forward with your rear foot, repeating the lunge on the opposite leg.

name: walking on incline treadmill
instructions: Adjust the incline level on the treadmill to your desired intensity.
Stand on the treadmill with your feet about shoulder width.
Start walking at a comfortable pace, ensuring that you keep proper form.
Activate your core muscles and keep your back straight during the exercise.
Continue walking on the incline treadmill for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
Gradually decrease the incline and speed of the treadmill to cool down before stopping.

name: walking on stepmill
instructions: Adjust the stepmill machine to a comfortable level.
Step onto the machine and place your hands on the handrails for support.
Start walking by placing one foot on a step and then the other, alternating between legs.
Keep an upright posture and activate your core muscles.
Continue walking for the desired duration or distance.
Gradually increase the intensity or speed as you become more comfortable with the exercise.
Remember to cool down and stretch after completing the exercise.

name: weighted bench dip
instructions: For this exercise you will need to place a bench behind your back and another one in front of you. With the benches perpendicular to your body, hold on to one bench on its edge with the hands close to your body, separated at shoulder width. Your arms should be fully extended.

The legs will be extended forward on top of the other bench. Your legs should be parallel to the floor while your torso is to be perpendicular to the floor. Have your partner place the dumbbell on your lap. Note: This exercise is best performed with a partner as placing the weight on your lap can be challenging and cause injury without assistance. This will be your starting position.

Slowly lower your body as you inhale by bending at the elbows until you lower yourself far enough to where there is an angle slightly smaller than 90 degrees between the upper arm and the forearm. Tip: Keep the elbows as close as possible throughout the movement. Forearms should always be pointing down.
Using your triceps to bring your torso up again, lift yourself back to the starting position while exhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: weighted close grip chin-up on dip cage
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing your torso and a grip closer than the shoulder width.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, keep your torso as straight as possible while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position. Tip: Keeping the torso as straight as possible maximizes biceps stimulation while minimizing back involvement.

As you breathe out, pull your torso up until your head is around the level of the pull-up bar. Concentrate on using the biceps muscles in order to perform the movement. Keep the elbows close to your body. Tip: The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.

After a second of squeezing the biceps in the contracted position, slowly lower your torso back to the starting position; when your arms are fully extended. Breathe in as you perform this portion of the movement.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: weighted cossack squats (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than about shoulder width and toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold a weight in front of your chest with both hands.
Shift your weight to one side and bring down your body by bending the knee of the side you shifted towards, while keeping the other leg straight.
Go as low as you can while maintaining balance and while keeping your chest up.
Push through the heel of the bent leg to come back to where you began.
Do it again on the other side, alternating between legs.

name: weighted crunch
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your feet flat on the ground or resting on a bench with your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.
Hold a weight to your chest, or you may hold it extended above your torso. This will be your starting position.
Now, exhale and slowly begin to roll your shoulders off the floor. Your shoulders should come up off the floor about 4 inches while your lower back remains on the floor.
At the top of the movement, flex your abdominals and hold for a brief pause.
Then inhale and slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.

name: weighted decline sit-up
instructions: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.
Place your hands behind your head and lock them together by clasping your fingers. This is the starting position.
Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Breathe out when performing this part of the exercise.
Once you feel the contraction for a second, lower your upper body back down to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: weighted donkey calf raise
instructions: Stand on a raised platform with your toes on the edge and your heels hanging off.
Hold onto a stable object for support.
Lift your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your heels back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted drop push up
instructions: Position low boxes or other platforms 2-3 feet apart.
Move to a pushup position between them, supporting yourself by placing your hands on the boxes.
With good posture, drop from the platforms by pressing up and moving your hands to shoulder width, cushioning your landing by absorbing the impact through the arm.

name: weighted front plank
instructions: Get into a prone position on the floor, supporting your weight on your toes and your forearms. Your arms are bent and directly below the shoulder.
Keep your body straight at all times, and hold this position as long as possible. To increase difficulty, an arm or leg can be raised.

name: weighted front raise
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your thighs.
While keeping your arms straight, breathe out and lift the dumbbells in front of you until they are at shoulder level.
Hold briefly at the top, then breathe in and bring down under control the dumbbells back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted hanging leg-hip raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Activate your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or slightly higher.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your legs back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted hyperextension (on stability ball)
instructions: Stance yourself face down on a stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your feet against a wall for stability.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Activate your core and lift steadily your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your upper body back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted kneeling step with swing
instructions: Start in a kneeling stance with your knees about hip width and your back straight.
Hold a weight in each hand, with your arms extended straight down in front of you.
Activate your core and swing the weights up and overhead, while keeping your arms straight.
Bring down the weights back down to the start stance and continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted lunge with swing
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width, holding a weight in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge stance.
As you lunge forward, swing the weights forward and upward, while keeping your arms straight.
Push off with your right foot and come back to where you began, swinging the weights back down.
Do it again with your left foot and continue alternating legs for your target rep count.

name: weighted muscle up
instructions: Grip the rings using a false grip, with the base of your palms on top of the rings. Initiate a pull up by pulling the elbows down to your side, flexing the elbows.

As you reach the top position of the pull-up, pull the rings to your armpits as you roll your shoulders forward, allowing your elbows to move straight back behind you. This puts you into the proper position to continue into the dip portion of the movement.
Maintaining control and stability, extend through the elbow to complete the motion.
Use care when lowering yourself to the ground.

name: weighted muscle up (on bar)
instructions: Grip the rings using a false grip, with the base of your palms on top of the rings. Initiate a pull up by pulling the elbows down to your side, flexing the elbows.

As you reach the top position of the pull-up, pull the rings to your armpits as you roll your shoulders forward, allowing your elbows to move straight back behind you. This puts you into the proper position to continue into the dip portion of the movement.
Maintaining control and stability, extend through the elbow to complete the motion.
Use care when lowering yourself to the ground.

name: weighted one hand pull up
instructions: Take hold of the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than about shoulder width.
Hang from the bar with your arm fully extended and your body straight.
Activate your core and pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbow and squeezing your back muscles.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Bring down your body back down to the start stance with control.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted overhead crunch (on stability ball)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet planted on the floor and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands and straighten your arms overhead.
Activate your abs and in a controlled manner curl your upper body forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your upper body back to the start.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted pull-up
instructions: Attach a weight to a dip belt and secure it around your waist. Grab the pull-up bar with the palms of your hands facing forward. For a medium grip, your hands should be spaced at shoulder width. Both arms should be extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip.
You'll want to bring your torso back about 30 degrees while creating a curvature in your lower back and sticking your chest out. This will be your starting position.
Now, exhale and pull your torso up until your head is above your hands. Concentrate on squeezing yourshoulder blades back and down as you reach the top contracted position.
After a brief moment at the top contracted position, inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position with your arms extended and your lats fully stretched.

name: weighted round arm
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Flex your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, while keeping your back straight.
Lift your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight flex in your elbows.
Continue lifting your arms until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold briefly at the top, then bring down under control your arms back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted russian twist
instructions: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.

Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Your arms should be fully extended in front of you perpendicular to your torso and with the hands clasped. This is the starting position.
Twist your torso to the right side until your arms are parallel with the floor while breathing out.
Hold the contraction for a second and move back to the starting position while breathing out. Now move to the opposite side performing the same techniques you applied to the right side.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: weighted russian twist (legs up)
instructions: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.

Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Your arms should be fully extended in front of you perpendicular to your torso and with the hands clasped. This is the starting position.
Twist your torso to the right side until your arms are parallel with the floor while breathing out.
Hold the contraction for a second and move back to the starting position while breathing out. Now move to the opposite side performing the same techniques you applied to the right side.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: weighted russian twist v. 2
instructions: Lie down on the floor placing your feet either under something that will not move or by having a partner hold them. Your legs should be bent at the knees.

Elevate your upper body so that it creates an imaginary V-shape with your thighs. Your arms should be fully extended in front of you perpendicular to your torso and with the hands clasped. This is the starting position.
Twist your torso to the right side until your arms are parallel with the floor while breathing out.
Hold the contraction for a second and move back to the starting position while breathing out. Now move to the opposite side performing the same techniques you applied to the right side.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: weighted seated bicep curl (on stability ball)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet planted on the floor and your back straight.
Hold a medicine ball with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and let your arms hang down by your sides.
While keeping your upper arms stationary, breathe out and curl the medicine ball up towards your shoulders.
Hold briefly at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Breathe in and bring down under control the medicine ball back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted seated twist (on stability ball)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet planted on the floor and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands close to your chest.
Activate your core and in a controlled manner rotate your upper body to one side, while keeping your hips stable.
Hold briefly at the end of the rotation, then in a controlled manner come back to where you began.
Do it again the rotation to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for your target rep count.

name: weighted side bend (on stability ball)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet about shoulder width and flat on the floor.
Hold a weight in one hand and place your other hand on your hip.
Activate your core and in a controlled manner flex sideways towards the weighted side, while keeping your back straight.
Hold briefly at the bottom, then in a controlled manner come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps, then switch sides.

name: weighted sissy squat
instructions: Standing upright, with feet at shoulder width and toes raised, use one hand to hold onto the beams of a squat rack and the opposite arm to hold a plate on top of your chest. This is your starting position.

As you use one arm to hold yourself, bend at the knees and slowly lower your torso toward the ground by bringing your pelvis and knees forward. Inhale as you go down and stop when your upper and lower legs almost create a 90-degree angle. Hold the stretch position for a second.
After your one second hold, use your thigh muscles to bring your torso back up to the starting position. Exhale as you move up.
Repeat for the recommended amount of times.

name: weighted squat
instructions: Start by positioning two flat benches shoulder width apart from each other. Stand on top of them and wrap the weighted belt around your waist with the amount of weight you feel comfortable with. Make sure your toes are facing out.
Once you are standing straight up with the weight hanging in between your legs, position your arms so that they are fully extended to the side of your body. This is the starting position.

Begin by bending the knees as you maintain a straight posture with the head up. Continue down until the angle between the upper leg and the calves becomes slightly less than 90-degrees (which is the point in which the upper legs are below parallel to the floor). Inhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: If you performed the exercise correctly, the front of the knees should make an imaginary straight line with the toes that are perpendicular to the front. If your knees are past that imaginary line (if they are past your toes) then you are placing undue stress on the knee and the exercise has been performed incorrectly.

Begin to move the body back up by pushing the floor of the flat bench with the ball of your foot mainly as you straighten the legs again and go back to the starting position. Exhale as you perform this portion of the exercise.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: weighted standing curl
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your upper body and breathe out as you curl the weights up to shoulder level.
Hold briefly at the top, then breathe in as you bring down under control the weights back down to the start stance.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted standing hand squeeze
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width and hold a weight in each hand.
Straighten your arms straight in front of you, palms facing each other.
Squeeze your hands together as hard as you can, by activating your forearms.
Hold the squeeze for a few seconds, then release.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted straight bar dip
instructions: Stance yourself between parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Bring down your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Hold briefly, then push yourself back up to the start stance by straightening your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted stretch lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width.
Take a step forward with your right foot, while keeping your back straight.
Bring down your body by bending your knees until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your right heel to come back to where you began.
Do it again with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs for your target rep count.

name: weighted svend press
instructions: Begin in a standing position.

Press two lightweight plates together with your hands. Hold the plates together close to your chest to create an isometric contraction in your chest muscles. Your fingers should be pointed forward. This is your starting position.
Squeeze the plates between your palms and extend your arms directly out in front of you in a controlled motion.
Pause at the top of the motion, and then slowly return to the starting position.

name: weighted three bench dips
instructions: For this exercise you will need to place a bench behind your back. With the bench perpendicular to your body, and while looking away from it, hold on to the bench on its edge with the hands fully extended, separated at shoulder width. The legs will be extended forward, bent at the waist and perpendicular to your torso. This will be your starting position.

Slowly lower your body as you inhale by bending at the elbows until you lower yourself far enough to where there is an angle slightly smaller than 90 degrees between the upper arm and the forearm. Tip: Keep the elbows as close as possible throughout the movement. Forearms should always be pointing down.
Using your triceps to bring your torso up again, lift yourself back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: weighted tricep dips
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge next to your hips.
Slide your butt off the front of the bench with your legs extended in front of you.
Keep your back close to the bench and your elbows slightly bent.
Bring down your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the start stance by straightening your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: weighted triceps dip on high parallel bars
instructions: Stance yourself between two parallel bars with your hands gripping the bars and your arms fully extended.
Flex your elbows and bring down your body until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Hold briefly, then push through your palms to straighten your arms and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: wheel rollerout
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place the wheel roller in front of you.
Place your hands on the handles of the wheel roller and straighten your arms straight out in front of you.
Activate your core muscles and in a controlled manner roll the wheel forward, while keeping your back straight and your abs tight.
Continue rolling forward until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Hold briefly, then in a controlled manner roll the wheel back towards your knees, maintaining control and while keeping your abs engaged.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: wheel run
instructions: Start in a plank stance with your hands on the wheel and your body straight.
Activate your core and start rolling the wheel forward by extending your arms.
Continue rolling until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Reverse the movement by pulling the wheel back towards your body, using your core and arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: wide grip pull-up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands wider than about shoulder width.
Activate your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar until your chin is above the bar.
Bring down your body back down to the start stance with control.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: wide grip rear pull-up
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using a wide grip.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar, bring your torso forward and head so that there is an imaginary line from the pull-up bar to the back of your neck. This is your starting position.

Pull your torso up until the bar is near the back of your neck. To do this, draw the shoulders and upper arms down and back while slightly leaning your head forward. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement. Tip: Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.
After a second on the contracted position, start to inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched.
Repeat this motion for the prescribed amount of repetitions.

name: wide hand push up
instructions: Start in a high plank stance with your hands wider than about shoulder width.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Bring down your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and come back to where you began.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: wide-grip chest dip on high parallel bars
instructions: Stance yourself on the parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Lean forward slightly and bring down your body by bending your elbows until your chest is just above the bars.
Hold briefly, then push yourself back up to the start stance by straightening your arms.
Continue for your target number of reps.

name: wind sprints
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar using a pronated grip. Your arms and legs should be extended. This will be your starting position.
Begin by quickly raising one knee as high as you can. Do not swing your body or your legs. 3
Immediately reverse the motion, returning that leg to the starting position. Simultaneously raise the opposite knee as high as possible.
Continue alternating between legs until the set is complete.

name: world greatest stretch
instructions: This is a three-part stretch. Begin by lunging forward, with your front foot flat on the ground and on the toes of your back foot. With your knees bent, squat down until your knee is almost touching the ground. Keep your torso erect, and hold this position for 10-20 seconds.

Now, place the arm on the same side as your front leg on the ground, with the elbow next to the foot. Your other hand should be placed on the ground, parallel to your lead leg, to help support you during this portion of the stretch.

After 10-20 seconds, place your hands on either side of your front foot. Raise the toes of the front foot off of the ground, and straighten your leg. You may need to reposition your rear leg to do so. Hold for 10-20 seconds, and then repeat the entire sequence for the other side.

name: wrist circles
instructions: Start by standing straight with your feet being shoulder width apart from each other. Elevate your arms to the side of you until they are fully extended and parallel to the floor at a height that is evenly aligned with your shoulders. Tip: Your torso and arms should form the letter "T: Your palms should be facing down. This is the starting position.

Keeping your entire body stationary except for the wrists, begin to rotate both wrists forward in a circular motion. Tip: Pretend that you are trying to draw circles by using your hands as the brush. Breathe normally as you perform this exercise.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

name: wrist rollerer
instructions: To begin, stand straight up grabbing a wrist roller using a pronated grip (palms facing down). Your feet should be shoulder width apart.

Slowly lift both arms until they are fully extended and parallel to the floor in front of you. Note: Make sure the rope is not wrapped around the roller. Your entire body should be stationary except for the forearms. This is the starting position.
Rotate one wrist at a time in an upward motion to bring the weight up to the bar by rolling the rope around the roller.
Once the weight has reached the bar, slowly begin to lower the weight back down by rotating the wrist in a downward motion until the weight reaches the starting position.
Repeat for the prescribed amount of repetitions in your program.
